description: one of my favorite recipes, taken from the pages of an old watkins magazine. i had long since lost it and was really excited when i found the recipe again online. i thought i'd post it here so i'd be sure not to lose it again. disregard the specifications for wheat free soy sauce if it's not applicable to your diet - my family is gluten free.

name: Marinated Lemon Lamb  Cutlets Or Chops
description: lamb cutlets or chops marinated with lemon. can be cooked on the grill, bbq or frypan. please note preparation time includes one hour marinating time.

name: Marinated Mushrooms Red Lion Inn Style
description:
the red lion inn is in  stockbridge, massachusetts, usa and this recipe is adapted from the red lion cookbook. i have posted this because i made them for hubby and want the recipe where i can find it. the addition of tabasco sauce sets this apart from most other marinated mushroom recipes.   
zwt region: usa.

name: Marinated Mushrooms With Shallots And Thyme
description: these delicious little bites solve all kinds of snacking dilemmas, from last-minute appetizers to late-night fridge raids. you will need to refrigerate these for at least 12 hours, which i did not include in the time. enjoy!

name: Marinated Pork And Red Onion Kebabs
description: i found this recipe in bon appetit several years ago and we really enjoy it. the kebabs need to marinate for at least 2 hours, but they can also be prepared a day in advance.

name: Margaret Lee S Easy Beef Goulash
description: this is a recipe i got from my boyfriend's mother when i was 16!  every time she made it for dinner, i would find an excuse to hang around.  i know it is overly simplistic, but it is comfort food to the max!  i have made it in the slow cooker as well.  after all these years, i still enjoy this every now and then.

name: Iranian Chicken With Rice  Morgh Polou
description:
this is a typical iranian recipe using fruit with a meat or  chicken.   the saffron gives it a golden color and the scent while it is cooking is wonderful.  it is not "spicy hot" but it is "spicy flavorful". 
there is a special way to cook iranian rice but i have simplified this recipe using plain cooked rice - i prefer basmati rice
i made this recipe using skinless boneless breasts - they turned out too dry i recommend that you use the whole chicken, skin on for this recipe

name: Mango Fool  Or Papaya Or Banana
description: posted for zwt, i haven't made it yet so yield and time are a guess.  any tropical fruit can be used here.  i would think the pudding might need some vanilla or coconut extract added once it's thickened.

name: Mantou   Baozi   Steamed Bun Dough I
description: this dough can be used to make chinese steamed buns, called mantou, or filled buns, called baozi.  these fluffy, chewy, warm and unusual breads are common breakfasts, sides and meals in much of china. they are especially popular in shanghai (baozi) and beijing (mantou), where window-stall and small shop vendors sell them.  because this is the less unhealthy version with some whole wheat substitutions, they can be finicky based on dampness and temperature -- i fnd adjusting down the amount of flour is the best bet.  these are fantastic piping hot, or with any of my three filling recipes!

name: Baked Blintzes With Fresh Blueberry Sauce
description: this is a barefoot contessa recipe which sounds wonderful because you bake the blintzes in a large casserole and then cut into squares vs. having to make individual pancakes.  they are topped with a wonderful fresh blueberry topping.  would be wonderful for a brunch!!!

name: Italian Beef In The Crock Pot
description: crock pot excellence! this recipe is so fast and has such a delicious zesty flavor!

name: Italian Beef And Green Pepper Sandwiches
description: this one came from my best friend, whose husband is a gourmet with the crock pot. great leftovers!

name: Mango Sorbet With Strawberry Daiquiri Sauce
description: serve this fresh and fruity crowd-pleaser at your next summertime picnic, bbq, or get together! a very quick and easy dessert. use store bought sorbet, or make your own. from better homes & gardens.

name: Mango  Blackberry Cassis  And Vanilla Mosaic
description: if you're searching for a show stopping dessert (that is secretly easy to make) to serve company, look no further. each gorgeous — and delicious — tricolored slice is a canvas of decorative swirls: vibrant orange, deep purple, and creamy white.

name: It S Easy Being Green Casserole
description: i picked my 5 favorite ingredients off the list and just started to think.... this is what i came up with

name: Banana Bars With Toasted Pecan Frosting
description: if you love banana you'll love these even if you don't you'll still like these!!

name: Maple   Mustard Glazed Salmon  3 Ingredients
description: this dish is to die for. serve with baby potato, asparagus, fresh steamed greens or a salad. a simple dish for a dinner party or to enjoy anyday. this dish is very simple and is best made with a good pure maple syrp -this will give you a superior flavour!use pure maple syrup and ensure your mustard is gluten free if your diet requires

name: Baked Beans Smoked With A Kick
description: made this up for a back yard bbq, playing a little corn hole and italian lawn bowling!

name: Maple Chicken And Vegetables For Two
description: a simple, tasty one-dish meal for two people. i adopted this recipe from the recipezaar account and have yet to try it.

name: Irish Oatmeal With Pears And Maple
description: a recipe from ricardo posted for zwt8

name: Irish Cream Chocolate Macadamia Nut Pie
description: oh my-don't do it!!! i will not take the blame on this one!!! you have been warned!!!

name: Maple Syrup Fried Eggs On Waffles
description: from a canadian website and posted for the zaar world tour to canada.  this is a different way to cook eggs and a yummy one at that!  it sure is simple enough.  *update* to the hype about this recipe!  a non stick pan is a must..once i did these over the campfire in cast iron and burned the heck out of the syrup, but that may have been my fault!  yes i have done brown and serve sausages in the pan with the syrup, just add a little more syrup.  and i have even done the sausages with some thinly sliced apples in a little butter and the syrup, cooked til tender then add the eggs and a little more syrup.  i personally don't like fried eggs or runny yolks, so for my portion i tend to break the yolk and loosely scramble the egg before dropping it in the hot syrup.....then i just let it cook kind of like and omelet with out mixing it too much until it sets then dump the whole thing on the waffle!  in a pinch we have this with frozen french toast but it is so much better with a nice fat crunch eggo!

name: Irish Coffee Teddy S Mommy Style
description: i hope i am not "reposting" i looked and didn't see this one. i make this for teddy's daddy when he's had a rough day or when he needs to relax. i don't use irish whiskey i have tried bushmills in this but it does not taste as good as our current favorite which is cutty sark a scotch whisky.

name: Irish Brownies With Irish Cream Frosting
description: based on a recipe from my treasury of home baking cookbook. cook time doesn’t include the 1 hour chill time.

name: Irish Bread Pudding  With Whiskey Sauce
description: here's another recipe from the newsletter i receive.  a different version of bread pudding.  this one i will also make for  st. paddy's day!

name: Bam S Beefy Cabbage Vegetable Soup
description:
this is a first attempt soup and a mish-mash of what i have in the fridge. economical and comforting! you may substitute any kind of noodles, almost any kind of soup-friendly veggies, and season to taste.

serve with fresh baked french bread and a green salad.

name: Jack S Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
description: a "friend" of ours told my husband that invitations to social functions depend him bringing his famous ice cream.  this is very rich.  this recipe was taken from the kansas city star newspaper august 19, 1958.

name: Lychee And Pineapple Stir Fry Sauce
description: this is a no-fail stir-fry sauce made with fruit juices.  add this to chicken, beef or vegetables in your wok when they are 75% cooked.  you can also use this as a dip for spring rolls or other appetizers!

name: Jicama Mango Salad With Mozzarella   Chilies
description: jicama salads are so refreshing and crunchy. when you buy a jicama be sure it has a firm smooth light brown peel, no wrinkles or mold spots. when you cut into it the flesh should be very white. peel deep enough that the brown outer peel and the coarse (like woven linen)inner peel comes off too. they are very easy to peel and cut. i like to serve this very cold but it is fine at room temperature too.

name: Joan S Weeknight Shepherd S Pie
description: my mother made this for me when i was growing up.

name: Baked Eggs In Bread  Weight Watchers
description: this is an amazing recipe, and super easy. i found it at nobelpig.com - check out the website for some other great recipes! also, it's only 4 ww points per serving! :)

name: Joan And John S Corn Pudding
description: this recipe was formulated by my mother-in-law and me after reviewing and testing many different recipes. this is a savory corn pudding and not a sweet one.

name: Jo Mama S World Famous Lasagna
description: wondering what to do with leftover sauce when you make recipe #22782? here is the perfect answer. don't skimp on the sauce--this is best when you use 6-7 cups of sauce. prep time assumes you have already made sauce. i like to make this up in 2 smaller casseroles so i can serve my family one and freeze the 2nd one for later.

name: Baked Eggs And Ham For Two
description: try this when you want a light supper.

name: Jim S Goodie S Bbq  Rub
description: good on steaks or oven roast

name: Low Fat Baked Stuffed French Toast
description: sounds impossible, doesn't it? i found this amazing recipe in cooking light magazine a few years ago and have been making it ever since. this is great for entertaining at brunch, as all of the work is done the night before.

name: Baked Eggplant With Mushroom Tomato Sauce
description: not normally an eggplant fan, but this is really good.  from cheap, healthy, good blog.

name: Low Carb Sugar Free Spiced Cocoa
description: nothing defines the holiday season like a nice cup on hot chocolate or as my family called it cocoa. a lot of people don't realize the amazing health benefits of cocoa. a recent study has found that cocoa is rich in powerful antioxidants. antioxidants can protect you against a range of diseases and reduce the effects of aging.

name: Low Fat Chicken And Avocado Quesadillas
description: from calorie commando

name: Jewish Apple Cake Ala Grossinger S
description: i adapted this recipe from "the art of jewish cooking"  by jennie grossinger of the famous catskills "grossinger's resort" this cakes is very simple yet delicious. make sure that you use fresh, crispy apples! i use the kitchenaid for the whole thing.

name: Low Fat Crab And Corn Chowder
description: a lower fat version of a corn chowder recipe i found online.

name: Low Fat High Taste Breakfast Omelette
description: i'm always looking for high taste low fat foods...here's one that i was experimenting in the kitchen this morning. wonderful! leave me reviews and let me know what you think!

name: Low Fat Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
description: i love the nice herb flavor of this chicken dish. easy enough for family meals, but elegant enough for company dinners too.

name: Low Fat Low Sugar Cheesecake Icing
description:
i put this together after seeing a few different diabetic recipes online.  everyone at worked loved it, especially that it wasn't super sweet.

you can substitute the pudding and extract for different flavors

name: Jen S Ham   Cheese Toasted Sandwiches
description:
a little different from other sandwiches as you top them with the cheese and place under a grill instead of using as part of the filling.
this is a great crowd pleaser for brunch especially after christmas when you may want to use up some of that ham. easily put together when time permits, even the night before if kept in the fridge. served with some fresh juice to start while they are cooking and finished off with a cinnamon teacake & hot freshly brewed coffee you have a great brunch menu for family & friends. you can also add in other ingredients to the filling if wished, such as avocado, tomatoes, onions etc.  i often make this for a quick lunch to eat either on its own or with a soup in winter.  for the two of us i just use 4 slices bread and "eyeball" the rest of the ingredients :)

name: Baked Eggs With Bacon And Tomatoes
description:
from sobeys inspired magazine spring 2011 with adjustments.
you can use jarred red peppers if you like.

name: John Ed S Ground Beef Casserole
description: note:  this recipe has been updated!  this was elswet's papaw's "saturday afternoon" recipe. he prepared it himself, often. he said it was an old navy recipe he remembered from wwii, and it was one of his favorite dishes. it has a slight pizza taste, which makes it a favorite among kids, is very easy to assemble, and gives you hands free cooking.  note:  this recipe has been adjusted, slightly.  ;)

name: Jalapeno Corn Muffins With Honey Butter
description: these are yummy, no cheese in this one but the honey or maple butter fits perfectly here, even with the jalapeño. recipe makes 8 muffins so for small families it wont be to much. just double the amounts for more. from toh

name: Low Carb Friendly Chicken Mushroom Wrap
description: im on a low carb nutrition plan and im always experimenting with different food. i cam up with this sandwich wrap and its wonderful. i have to remind myself its ok to eat cause it taste so good. i have it figured at 6 net grams of carb.

name: Junior League   Hudson S Corn Pudding
description: this is a fabulous recipe from chefs jeff blank and jay moore of hudson's-on-the-bend in lakeway, tx.

name: Baked Fish With Lemon Mushroom Sauce
description: an easy dish - delicious!

name: Julienne Of Veal Poultry Pork   Microwave
description: the original recipe called for raw veal. i have changed it to use leftovers, add color and create more sauce. the fun here is that you can use other spices or herbs in place of nutmeg, add more veggies, whatever suits.

name: Julie S Rhubarb Bars Or Crisp
description: a recipe i got from a co worker.  scrumptious.  she substituted butter for shortening in the recipe and it was divine.

name: Julia S Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: my roommate in college used to make these and the whole plate would last a few minutes. they are really yummy! p.s. not really sure of the servings, it makes quite a few.

name: Low Carb Brownies With Chocolate Frosting
description: finally! a great tasting brownie that taste's like it wasn't low carb! i found the recipe online someplace and made my own changes. the frosting can be added,(its great that way) or left off. made with almond flour.it keeps really great in the frig, also.

name: Judy S Vegetable Soup From Cans
description: this recipe came from soupsong.com. i found it a few years ago and i have been making it ever since. it is great on cold winter night or a busy work day. enjoy.

name: Joyce S Cheese N Chicken Dinner
description: my friend joyce gave me this recipe some time ago and while i have only made it twice, it was wonderful both times.

name: Low Carb Shrimp With Creole Sauce
description: i made this for my best friend's birthday. she is on a low-carb diet but i was also cooking for kids and men (a challenge!) i had no leftovers. this came from a bon appetit magazine. very easy and very good.

name: Joy S Life Diet Soup Creole
description:
if you are apart of the joy bauer's diet this is one of 3 different life soup's you should have every day with dinner if you don't have a salad. since this site makes it so much easier to plan shopping lists i'm adding them here.

it's a inexpensive diet feel free to check it out here: http://www.joybauer.com/members/foodandrecipes/recipes/viewrecipe.aspx?recipeid=10499&usermealplanid=84263771

name: Baked Farfalle With Prosciutto And Mushrooms
description: this delicious baked pasta dish can also be made with pancetta, which is much cheaper than prosciutto and just as tasty.

name: Jolean S Crock Pot Spanish Chicken
description: this is a recipe that my mom always made for us in the 70's, which i found in her original 1970 crock pot recipe booklet (with the page "dog-eared" and check-marked), and over the years has been tweaked just a bit for our own tastes...super easy, and since i've been married (and divorced) twice now, i can honestly tell you that it is a "man-pleaser" as well as a kid-friendly recipe.  i make this at least a couple of times every month, and they always ask me when i'm going to make it again!  really tasty, and easy too, since you dump everything in the crock pot in the morning and when you all come home from work or school, the house smells amazing!!!

name: Jolean S Company Baked Egg Frittata
description: my mom rarely cooked us breakfast, but when we had company she went "all out". this is a very simple recipe.  there are probably lots of similar ones out there, but this one is dear to my heart because it was truly a "special occasion" whenever my mom made this. i still love it to this day, although i've embellished it plenty from time to time--yum! note for zaar world tour ii:  frittatas are italian in origin.

name: Baked Eggs With Peppers And Mushrooms
description: this is so much easier than last-minute omlets and this delicious dish can be baked without any attention from the cook! serve with a mixed fruit salad and canadian bacon for a breakfast treat.from a march 1989 issue of bon appetit.

name: Johnny Jalapeno S Taco Cornbread Skillet
description: cooking in a cast iron skillet is the true cowboy way and no one knows about cowboy cooking more than the famous outlaw, 'johnny jalapeno'! rumor has it he was almost lynched by the famed mcdaniel gang over this recipe. they shouted "this ain't no derned cowboy supper, ain't no beans in it!" well, johnny ran quick as lightning over to the campfire, and made another skillet supper, this time adding the last can of beans he had! saved his life them beans did! ;)  also try johnny's recipe #266664.

name: Johnny Garlic S Cedar Plank Salmon
description: wow!

name: Low Fat Penne A La Vodka
description: this is a low fat version of recipe #214699, requested by mosma in the "lighten up your favorite comfort food" game. if you don't care for mushrooms, just omit them.

name: Low Fat Roasted Sweet Potato Salad
description: a light potato salad that i serve when i want to wow people.  this is served warm or at room temperature.  i got this recipe from my sister.

name: Low Fat Spinach Dip Potato Salad
description: i came up with this recipe when i was asked to review a brand of greek yogurt for my weekend carnivore (http://weekendcarnivore.com) cooking blog. i figured that i enjoy both spinach dip and potato salad. so, why not combine the two?  cooking time doesn't include the chilling time since it is up to you how long you chill it.

name: Low Fat Zippy Kidney Bean Dip
description: diabetic (high fiber) suggested dippers: celery, jicama, cabbage, pita points.

name: Low Fat Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: these came from a pillsbury healthy baking cookbook.  they make a small batch, so double if you're serving them to more than a couple of people.  also, the dough can get a little dry near the end sometimes.  adding a little bit of milk or chocolate liqueur will help loosen it up nicely.

name: Low Fat Glazed Cranberry Mini Loaves
description: these bake out very high with a nice point on top and are extremely moist with lots of flavor, no one would ever guess they are low fat! ---fresh or frozen blueberries may be used in place of cranberries but do not chop the blueberries--- i have yield at 20 (10 slices per loaf) this is of coarse only estimated it will depend on the size you slice the loaves --- you may omit the glaze if desired --- depending if you are using sweetened or unsweetened orange juice you may want to adjust the sugar amount, i used unsweetened orange with 1 cup sugar and found that to be the perfect sweetness.

name: Jamika S Salmon With Pineapple Salsa
description: this recipe was developed by jamika pessoa, one of the finalists on "the next food network star" television show.  she prepared this dish for the editor of good housekeeping, along with the panel of weekly judges, and her recipe won top honors in this particular challenge.

name: Jamie Oliver S Best Pasta Salad
description: one of my favorite naked chef recipes. i make this often. i just love the trip of boiling up the garlic cloves with the pasta, and then just squeezing them out of their skins and adding them mashed to the dressing.

name: Jambalaya W Shrimp  Chicken And Sausage
description: had this for the first time at a dinner party, now i have to make it every month or so. it's better if you have the sausage, chicken and shrimp prepared before starting, that way you can dig in once the rice is cooked.

name: Low Fat Pancakes With Orange Sauce
Low Fat Vegetable And Pasta Casserole
description: a good casserole for dieters.

name: Baked Chicken With Honey And Pecans
description: this is almost like dinner and a dessert in one. it's not quite that sweet, but i love the flavor of the honey and pecans. sorta like a praline, but not quite. the chicken comes out moist and tender. it's so easy to make too. i like to throw all the seasonings into a ziploc bag, then put the chicken in and shake until coated. then you can just throw the bag out.

name: Jell O Lime Margarita  Virgin  Smoothie
description: go green with this beverage from the folks at jell-o!

name: Lower Fat Cinnamon Swirl Quick Bread
description: this is an easy and delicious cinnamon swirl bread. my family loves it...it's hard to keep on the shelf for long!   this is lower fat because my recipe substitutes applesauce for most of the oil, but you cannot tell..it makes it better i think.  we also don't make the glaze all the time- and love the bread even without it!

name: Lowrey S Easy Meat And Gravy
description: my dh threw this together one night when i didn't feel like cooking and we loved it!! we serve it often with mashed potatoes and corn. we have even substituted pork chops or shoulder steaks for the beef.

name: Jam Filled Iced Rolls Danish S
description: this sounds yummy,i look foward to trying these ones out on my family!

name: Luby S Cafeteria Chicken Fried Steak
description:
“chicken frying” steak originated as a way of tenderizing less-tender yet great-tasting cuts of meat.  no southern cookbook is complete without a recipe for this regional favorite.  
use any flour remaining from the breading process for the cream gravy.  from the luby's cafeteria 50th anniversary cookbook.

name: Luby S Cafeteria Jefferson Davis Pie
description: for cafeteria fans.  a true southern favorite.

name: Jalapeno Steak  N  Mushrooms  Slow Cooker
description: there's nothing better than a juicy steak in the summertime or any time. try this slow-cooked version, simmered in a savory garlic sauce and paired with fresh mushrooms, onions, and jalapenos.

name: Baked Chicken Masala With Almond Pilaf
description: "this superhealthy recipe proves watching what you eat doesn't mean you have to banish curry from your menu plan". from the bbc

name: Low Fat Cherry Cheesecake Pudding Pie
description: this is a wonderful dessert, you can make it look very elegant or just down home, you decide.

name: Japanese Eggyolk Sauce  Mayonnaise  For Seafood
description: this recipe is one i recently adopted. i have not yet tried it, but it sounds as though this recipe is great! here's what the original poster had to say about this recipe: "i came across a request for an eggyolk sauce recipe on the forum. i did a little research on the net and since i found so many requests, i decided i need to try this. so this is my version of the widely searched sauce. i don't know whether it is anything like the real stuff, so i appreciate if people would tell me so in a review. in any case i believe this is a nice recipe for a little different homemade mayonnaise, that tastes good with seafood. on tasting it, i believe that variations with wasabi, ginger or garlic would be very nice as well."

name: Baked Cod With Mushrooms And Scallions
description: just looking for something new to do with a bit of cod, and came up with this delicious and simple dish. the bay leaf is the key ingredient, but make sure you use a small one, as it will take over otherwise.

name: Low Fat Black And White Cookies
description: since i'm not a native new yorker, i can't say how these compare to the full fat version.  nevertheless, these are delightful, soft cookies with just a hint of lemon.  they are wonderful when in the mood for something a little different. recipe taken from cooking light.

name: Low Fat Taters  Breaded French Fries
description: you should really experiment with the seasonings... it's a great way of changing up the flavours.  try and use hebamare in most recipes rather than just plain salt, and in this recipe i always try and use hebamare spicy.  try it with extra garlic or onion powder sometime as well.  this is an adaptation of an adaptation, but just fantastic all the same!  original recipe was in the "kitchen with rosie" book, or so i am told.

name: Jeff Probst S Oscar S Delight
description: watched this dish being prepared on live with regis and kelly and thought it sounded good to try. prep/cook time does not include marinating time.

name: Baked Couscous With Tomato And Pesto
description: a donna hay winter recipe

name: Low Low Fat Best Blueberry Muffins
description: delicious, rises well, and turns a gorgeous caramel color in the oven. hard to tell it's low fat, an amazing recipe indeed.smells great, tastes great, an absolute staple in your kitchen. feedback appreciated!

name: Jean Pare S Peanut Butter Treats
description: peanut butter and chocolate together .... yum!

name: Jay S Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
description:
this recipe was found in an old cookbook title "cooking with pioneers", published in tennessee.

very easy cookie recipe made with easily found ingredients.  recipe says it makes 6 dozen, but i got about 40 cookies out of it.

name: Low  Calorie Cabbage  Red Bean Soup
description: this is very tasty and filling. great for watching calories an fat.i like putting this in my crock pot and simmer all day.

name: Jasmine Rice Salad With Snap Peas
description: very easy summer salad. my mother loves this recipe so much that she started growing her own snap peas. the spices in this recipe is quite flexible: fennel seeds and mustard seeds are also good additions. i also experimented with curry powder and it was very appetizing as well!

name: Balsamic Onion  Mushroom   Blue Cheese Tarts
description: these little guys are great to add to appetizer platters for parties and would also be great to pack in a picnic basket. the sticky sweetness of the balsamic onions works well with earthiness of the mushrooms and blue cheese. they are good cold. so, you don't have to worry about cooking them and keeping them warm during your event.

name: Baked Corn In Creamy Cheese Sauce
description: feel free to add in some other vegetables also, i have even added in some cooked leftover cubed potatoes.

name: Low Calorie Oozing Maple Fruit Bowl
description:
i whipped this sugar-free snack up last night because i wanted something that resembled a fruit crisp, but without the calories, of course. i find i am not impressed with baked foods containing granulated splenda, but i do enjoy items i buy at the store containing splenda, such as sugar-free maple syrup, chocolate syrup, hot cocoa, etc. so i came up with this which is very easy and yummy and versatile! (play around with different fruits, different cereals, added ingredients...) also, amazing topped with free cool whip.
and just to let you know, all of these ingredients can be adjusted, in amounts, to your own personal liking.

let me know how you like it! ^_^

name: Low Carb Bacon And Egg Quiche
description: i'm trying to go low-carb, and i found this recipe on recipegal.com. it's so easy to make and tastes great! we use cheddar as nobody likes swiss cheese but me. it originally calls for a quiche pan, but i just used a 9-inch pie pan with great results! i also  sprayed it with non-stick canola cooking spray, instead of the butter as the recipe originally called for.

name: Baked Cod With Tomato Olive Tapenade
description: fast and delicious

name: Japanese Steakhouse Style Golden Shrimp Sauce
description: posted in reply to a request. i haven't tried this recipe, though i've had the sauce in japanese restaurants and it's quite good served on grilled shrimp. i found this on recipegal.com and the poster there claimed this is just like the original stuff found in restaurants.

name: Japanese Rice With Shrimp And Vegetables
description:
this is a delicious rice recipe with such a wonderful flavour to it. i like this dish very much! : )
i couldn't find dashi stock so i used miso soup instead.
and if you don't want to use fresh shrimp you can use precooked peeled shrimp. just add them in the last minute of cooking to heat through.

name: New Potato Salad With Avocado Dressing
description: created for craze-e salad contest; sub category is --picnic salad at the park.  this is a happy marriage of two favorite recipes: potato salad and avocado dressing. and of the course, the bacon and hard cooked eggs make it perfect!

name: New Potatoes With A Chili Sauce
description: a tapas recipe. serve with toothpicks.

name: Haeda S Oatmeal Craisin Breakfast Cookies
description: healthy home made oatmeal craisin breakfast cookies! i made up this recipe while i was in my first year of college and these made great healthy morning snacks. this makes around 16 cookies.

name: Peanut Butter Sugared Hong Kong Waffles
description: i had these pretty much everyday in hong kong.  and not just once a day, but whenever i could!  these are very common street snacks, and once you try them, i'm sure they will become part of your routine also!  hong kong waffles are larger than standard american waffles, but i've found that it doesn't matter much - it still tastes just as good.  there is nothing healthy in these, that's the intention, but they are sweet and delicious!  if there is a certain waffle recipe you adore, feel free to use that in place of the standard one i have provided.  i've provided my simple, painless waffle recipe. "recipe #291392"

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
description: made with prepared refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough. this recipe from pillsbury classic cookbooks -5 ingredients or less june 2004.

name: Fruit Fridge Cake Squares   No Bake
description: christmas time in south africa is the hottest time of the year. these rich fruit cake type squares were a part of our cold christmas buffet usually eaten around the family pool.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate No Bake Bars
description: great quick and easy...the kids love them

name: Fruit Cake Slice With Lemon Icing
description:
a great recipe for leftover christmas cake or pudding. i saw this recipe on the seven sunrise show and remember a friend's mum
making something like years ago. 
she would use up her leftover christmas pudding and cakes during the year to make this, and it tasted very nice indeed.
i am not sure if this is the exact same recipe, but it sure looks close to it.
i always have leftovers, and never quite sure what to use them in but this year i will freeze the leftover pudding and cake to use later in this recipe.
slice can be made up to 5 days ahead or freeze for up to 2 months. thaw at room temperature, before serving.

name: Peanut Butter Icing   Frosting For Cookies
description: thick frosting that dries sort of shiny - perfect for cookies that need to be stacked and taken somewhere.  i like the recipes i've seen for plain icing that dries, and played with it to make a peanut butter version since my father in law is always asking for peanut butter cookies.  prep time doesn't include frosting the cookies, which will vary depending on how detailed you get.  i iced 32 (2-3") cookies.

name: Fruit And Cream Cheese Breakfast Pastry
description: sweet pastry treat for a quick breakfast! they'll think you bought it from a pastry chef! can be made the night before, and baked the next day!

name: Peanut Butter Oat Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: there are many versions of this recipe, but this the best! 8) very rich and perfect for the chocolate and peanut butter lovers out there! 8)

name: Frozen Lemonade Or Fruit Juice Slushies
description: an icy treat for hot weather! kids will love this and parents will to. things don't taste as sweet when cold so people who like sweeter lemonade will want extra sweetener while those who prefer a tarter drink will not. adults may enjoy the optional rum or whiskey. any excess may be frozen in popsicle molds. variation: try frozen juice concentrates instead of the lemonade concentrate. i like grapefruit, my kids like grape. try orange slushies for a summer brunch.

name: Fruit Salad With Sweet Orange Cream
description: chopped nuts, shredded coconut or mint leaves would be a perfect garnish.

name: Peanut Butter  Banana  And Mayonnaise Sandwich
description:
i don't know exactly how elvis ate this sandwich (i think he fried it), but this is my family's way of making this sandwich since i was a little girl. i craved these terribly while i was pregnant.
edited to add-reviewer bev is right- miracle whip makes it better than mayo! i used honey roasted peanut butter on my last one and it was (with the miracle whip) the best. sandwich!!! i could eat one everyday!

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Banana Cream Pie
description:
my family loves this recipe. i found it in a kraft food & family book. i will give the original recipe here. i have made a few changes for our family such as i like reeses peanut butter and i use semi-sweet chocolate chips if i don't have the bakers chocolate. i hope you all enjoy it as much as we do. 
shortcut: you can substitute a prepared nilla pie crust for the nilla wafers and butter. cooking time is actually refrigeration time.

name: Peanut Butter Coconut Raisin Granola Bars
description: this a wonderful afternoon snack or to take on a walk in the park.

name: Frozen Edible Cookie Dough  No Eggs
description: if you're like me and buy the frozen cookie dough and end up eating it before you even get to bake cookies... this is for you! note: you can use less sugar if using a sweet chocolate or more sugar if using semi-sweet or dark chocolate.

name: Frozen Chocolate Peanut Butter Ribbon Torte
description: slightly adapted recipe from the national honey board - this decadent dessert is easy to whip together - layering chocolate ice cream, peanut butter parfait and rich, dark chocolate sauce.

name: Peanut Dipping Sauce With A Kick
description: i searched through the many peanut dipping sauces on 'zaar and couldn't find a duplicate of how i make my sauce...so here it is!

name: Peanut Chocolate Brownie Treats  No Bake
description: easy to make and addicting!

name: Astonishingly Easy  Yeasty  Bisquick Pizza Dough
description:
this amazed me when i first came up with it. the yeast is basically a flavoring agent, the dough works pretty well without it but it does add a tiny bit of springy-ness. 
measurements are (very) approximate, just follow the directions...

name: Peanut Butter Candy Bars  Cookie Mix
description: source: betty crocker note: cookie mix used is 1 pouch (1 lb 1.5 oz) betty crocker® peanut butter cookie mix

name: Pear And Ginger Brown Butter Tart
description: recipe by: nancy silverton

name: Gai Lan  Chinese Broccoli  And Beef
description: my chinese roommate taught me to make this yummy dish. mostly because she got tired of making it for me as i can't get enough of it. this is so good and your house will be filled with wonderful smells. if you like garlic this is a must.

name: Pb J Whoopie Pies  Cake Mix
description:
i had made half a box of mini cupcakes and wanted to do something fun with the other half of the batter so i decided to make some peanut butter and jelly whoopie pies. they taste like a sweet peanut butter and jelly sandwich. i didn't see any recipes for anything like these on here so i figured i would share. i've only made these once so i'm sure there are improvements that could be made. i might use chocolate instead of white cake mix next time to make them a little more different. 
caloric content is a bit high, at about 230 calories per pie (using egg beaters and reduced sugar jam) but more than worth it.

name: Pc Tex Mex Chicken   Rice Skillet
description: this a pampered chef recipe  from thier 29 minutes to dinner cookbook.

name: Garden Burgers For Your Freezer   Oamc
description: for those of you those of you that have looked at the price in the freezer section or bought veggie burgers you know they cost far more than it takes to make them. this makes about 24 so you can freeze them and have them whenever you want! i would suggest making a smaller amount and adjusting the taste to your desire...these are good for me!

name: Pea Soup With Sausage   Crock Pot
description: wonderful easy winter soup.

name: Gammon  Ham Steaks  With Whiskey Sauce
description: a lovely dish with flavors that are hearty.

name: Gamma D S Boiled Spice Cake
description: my next door neighbors mother gave me this recipe. it was one of her mothers little cakes she often made to go along with tea or coffee. very easy to make and very, very tasty.

name: Peach And Walnut  Or Pecans  Salad
description: nice luncheon salad, serve with a cheese biscuit , or cinnamon toast.benefits from a couple of hours of chilling. evolved to our taste from cooking light.

name: Ga Lui  Skewered Five Spice Chicken
description: recipe by nicole routhier, found in

name: Peanut Butter Butterscotch Bars  No Bake
description: these bars are majorly intense!

name: Fusilli With Garlic  Figs  And Rosemary
description: pasta for all seasons

name: Peach  Plum  Nectarine  Or Cherry Filling
description: quick and easy pie or tart filling from "everyday with rachael ray."

name: Peaches And Cream With Raspberry Sauce
description: this is a great recipe for peaches in season, with the added benefit of being low in fat when made as written. you can even throw some granola on top for a little crunch.

name: Peanut Butter   Chocolate Chips Banana Bread
description: this is a combination of recipes for different tastes and types of cooking, and here it is!

name: Peanut Butter And Apple Bacon Sandwiches
description: i don't usually post recipes i have not tried, but i came across this from better homes and gardens,10/2007, and wanted to get it saved on zaar.  i can already taste my lunch tomorrow.  yum!  this original recipe is to make four sandwiches, so if you are cooking for one you will have to adjust.

name: Peanut Butter And Banana Breakfast Smoothie
description: this came from the dash diet recipe cookbook. i have not tried this, just posting for safe keeping.

name: Fruit  Honey And Coconut Energy Bars
description: why pay almost $3 or $4 for an overpriced box of trail mix-style bars when you can make your own easily? a 6 ounce bag of puffed brown rice cereal goes for 80 cents at our local supermarket, and 6 ounces is a lot of puffed rice! you can use natural, low-sugar or low-fat peanut butters, use raisins instead of dried cherries or substitute chocolate or carob chips for the coconut (or include everything you can!). in addition to the sunflower seeds, i like to add sesame seeds for extra crunch as well.

name: Asparagus  Snap Pea And Avocado Salad
description: from everyday food magazine.

name: Pear Bread With Vanilla And Ginger
description: beth hensperger

name: Paula Deen S Taco Soup    Modified
description: my healthier version of this soup paula made on her game night episode.

name: Asparagus With Fontina And Cream Sauce
description: another great recipe for asparagus. the recipe was created for the stockon ca. asparagus festival and comes from kcra tv.

name: Fried Apple Pancake Rings Carla Hall
description: this recipe uses pancake batter to coat apple rings, then fried to perfection with an apple cider syrup! you can substitute whole wheat pancake batter or make your own. i have added my own recipe for apple cider syrup. the original called for reducing the cider by half and gave no amounts. this one is much quicker and yummy. i didn't have bisquick, so made my own from a recipe on this site, substituting about 1/3 of the flour with whole wheat flour. from carla hall on the new abc program, the chew. hootie!

name: Penne With Butter  Sage  And Parmesan
description: this simple recipe makes a great accompaniment to grilled chicken.  the quality of parmesan really matters here; avoid the stuff in the green container for this preparation!

name: Asparagus With Lemon Broth  Low Sodium
description: this is a recipe from the no salt cookbook.  very tasty side dish that is flavorful in spite of the fact that it's low sodium.  feel free to substitute veggie broth to turn this into a fabulous vegetarian/vegan dish.

name: Asparagus With Lemon And Parmesan Butter
description: these flavours go so well together!

name: Asparagus With Herbed Cheese On Toast
description: i got this off the internet somewhere and it looked very tempting. i haven't tried this yet, so it's here for safekeeping!

name: Penne With Classic Bolognese Meat Sauce
description: rachael ray

name: Penne With Collards Sausage  And Mushrooms
description: adapted from southern living. the type of sausage you need is the kind that comes in a long link that you can slice into thin rounds. you may use any flavor of smoked sausage you like - you may even use a chicken or turkey sausage if you prefer.

name: Fresh Tomato And Goats Cheese Quiche
description: this quiche is the best i have ever had. it has a bit of a bite to it with the chilli pepper sauce although you could leave this out. the parmesan pastry also adds to the flavour. this came from a bbc calendar for september.

name: Pegge S World Famous Cheese Grits
description: the only request my new husband had for our first holiday meal together was cheese grits.  having never had them before i called his mother for her recipe and have been hooked ever since!  update: i wanted to cut the fat content so tried this recipe with light velveeta and cut the butter to 1/3 cup.  we couldn't tell the difference and cut the fat content by about a third!

name: Fresh Tomato And Garlic Pasta Sauce
Penne With Salmon And Roasted Vegetables
description:
you'll be hooked by the sweet, mellow flavor of the caramelized vegetables and the tender texture of the salmon. from prevention healthy cooking.
http://www.eatbetteramerica.com/recipes/dinner/penne-with-salmon-and-roasted-vegetables.aspx

name: Penne With Shrimp  Asparagus  And Parmesan
description: i don't remember where i found this recipe which i adapted to our tastes. it may have been weight watchers but i just can't be sure.

name: Fresh Strawberry Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
description: from a recipe handout i got when i went picking strawberries. moist and delicious! it taste like a strawberry cream cheese danish. it's easier than some recipes since the cream cheese is mixed into the batter and not used as a separate layer. you could also serve it as a dessert with ice cream on top like a cobbler.

name: Fresh Spinach With Leeks In Pernod
description: pernod is the brand name of the licorice- flavored french liqueur pastis. you will find it under either of these names, as well as ricard. it has been used as an ingredient in aperitiefs and in cooking for over 200 years! this is a fantastically easy as well as attractive dish we really enjoy - the pernod tempers the bitterness you sometimes have with fresh spinach. i've put in a minimal prepartion time as this will really depend on how gritty your spinach and leek are. if you've never drunk pernod before, consider giving it a try-- i'm also posting the recipe for the drink pernod classique (pastis), which is a really refreshing summer drink. millions of frenchman can't all be wrong . . .

name: Pennsylvania Dutch Hot Slaw For Sausages
description: fried sausages or hot smoked sausages are placed on top of this hot slaw. serve them with plenty of mashed potatoes. yummy! prep time is approximate.

name: Fresh Plum   Blueberry Upside Down Cake
description: this is such a beautiful and easy cake! i was so excited when i flipped it over and wow - it really is impressive! i can't wait until my husband comes home to see/eat it!

name: Asparagus With Tofu And Balsamic Butter
description: this is a donna hay recipe. the combination of flavors and textures is wonderful. the sauce is really versatile, and could be easily be used for other veggies. it is quick and easy to make, and makes a great vegetarian meal served over brown rice.

name: Bbq Chicken Breast With Zucchini Sauce
description: sounds yummy!  i haven't made this yet but when i do, i'll certainly be using home made chicken stock rather than water in the zucchini sauce. it makes sense that it's going to be more flavoursome; and i'll probably using slightly less than the 300ml specified (300ml = approximately 11/4 cups) so that i can add a little white wine, or champagne.  adapted from neil perry's recipe from fresh and fast, which i found on the lifestyle food channel website.

name: Asparagus  New Potato And Chive Frittata
description: welcome spring  or anytime with a yummy frittata, perfect for brunch, lunch or a light supper. the recipe comes from weightwatchers.com. points value 3.

name: Peasant Pasta   Fit For A King
description: this simple pasta dish is very cheap to make, just a few ingredients and a good olive oil turn this into a meal to relish. i cook the bones from a chicken carcass to make a stock, chicken stock cubes work well if you don't want to make your own stock. pasta shells are prefered in this dish as they catch the chick peas and the final result is like having a shell with an oyster inside. kids seem to go for this version of pasta that i cooked many times while in italy. serve topped with parmesan cheese and drizzled with olive oil.

name: Pear Cranberry Pie With Crumb Topping
description: scrumptious. from food and wine, '99. use your own favorite pie dough or store bought.

name: Frittata With Ham And Roasted Pepper
description: this recipe comes from coup de pouce, issue february 2008.  i'm posting it for zwt 4 italy.

name: Frijoles Con Queso Dip And Chips
description: posted for zaar world tour 2006

name: Frijoles Charros Rapidos  Quick Cowboy Beans
description: this is the second portion of making the quick cowboy beans. the first portion, frijoles de la olla tradicional recipe # 222108 explains the mexican way of cooking pinto beans. this is a quick version of the beans that are typically served in taquerias. they can be as smokey, spicy as you want, super satisfying version of the plain jane brothy beans.

name: Frijoles   Chilies Buttermilk Dip Or Sauce
description: this can be a dip for vegetables, chips or smoked meats. i add a little more milk to the dip to use as a sauce inside the tortillas when i make chicken or cheese enchiladas. white sauce inside, red sauce outside with cheese.

name: Peas With Baby Onions And Chervil
description: simple tasty recipe for peas.. based on a recipe from delicious magazine. this would go well with salmon.

name: Bbq Cedar Plank Salmon With Maple
description: a different, delicious way to cook salmon. very delectable, very gourmet, very easy!

name: Bbq Chicken And Blue Cheese Pizza
description: pizza with bbq sauce,chicken, onion, other veggies, and blue cheese.

name: Fried Mozzarella With Puttanesca Dipping Sauce
description: from emeril live, a wonderful yummy snack or make it lunch with a nice salad!

name: Fried Tofu With Tangy Chilli Dressing
description:
a delicious tofu snack!

tips:

* drain water from tofu after taking out of pack

name: Fried Rice With Sweet Soy Sauce
description: quick 30 minute side dish, or a light dinner

name: Pecan Blondies With Browned Butter Frosting
description: originally from "pillsbury best cookies cookbook"

name: Pecan Crusted Chicken With Raspberry Sauce
description: elegant yet simple and oh so good! add a salad and bread for a great dinner.

name: Fried Pork  Masas De Puerco Fritas
Fried Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich
description: sounds strange, but kids love it. i made these for my kids all the time. let it cool slightly before giving to younger children as the jelly can get hot.

name: Pecan Pie Bars With Shortbread Crust
description: one of my favorite bars, this works well also with walnuts! the shortbread crust is light and buttery, make certain to make the crust only on a processor, mixing by hand will produce a harder textured crust, also make certain to pour the topping over the crust when it is hot out of the oven, so prepare the topping while the crust is baking, the filling takes only minutes to make! yield is only estimated depending on size of bars. cooking time is for both crust and topping.

name: Paula S Chicken And Rice Casserole
description: another paula deen original! easy and delicious! we are not real big casserole people, but this was a big hit with the family.

name: Garlic And Bacon Roasted Potato Salad
description: this past weekend i went on a camping trip and my assignment was to bring the potato salad.  i wanted it to be absolutely perfect so i started messing around with recipes the week before and threw out a few batches before i came up with this.  the roasted potatoes enhance the flavor of the garlic and bacon and makes this a great tasting combination.  this is best made at least a day ahead so that the bacon flavor can really combine and penetrate the potatoes.  everyone absolutely loved it and i hope you do to.

name: Panini With Scrambled Eggs And Tomatoes
description: a recipe from the issue of april 2006 of coup de pouce.  this is an express recipe.

name: Pasta Frolla  Italian Sweet Pastry Dough
description: very versatile sweet dough...use with almond tart recipe which is among mine posted. from a booklet given to me by alitalia airlines.

name: Aunt Martha S Country Green Beans
description: these may just be the best green beans i've ever made.

name: Aunt Marilyn S Poppy Seed Salad
description: my aunt makes this salad and serves it before all holiday meals. it is beautiful and tastes amazing. be prepared to hand out the recipe!

name: German Chocolate And Milky Way Bars
description: i had these at the hope house at rochester. they were a hit with everyone there.  they are easy to make with a cake mix.

name: German Chicken Stew With Caraway Dumplings
description: huhnereintopf mit kummelklossen. eintopfgericht, means meal made in one pot. many of these german stews are prepared days in advance and they are excellent reheated. the final stew will be tender, with the chicken falling off the bone, and if you make it with caraway dumplings, you'll have a substantial meal that can feed a group of people.

name: Aunt Kathy S Mai Tai S
description: these have got to be the best mai tai's that we know of. i have adapted the recipe from who would have guess pillsbury paperback cookbook. there's a reason the dough boy is so happy!

name: General Tso S Chicken And Shrimp
description: pretty good, but not quite so healthy version of general tso's chicken. i am looking for ways to make it a bit healthier. if you have any ideas, please post. adapted from http://thymefornourishment.wordpress.com/2009/04/05/general-tsos-shrimp/.

name: General Tso S Chicken  Restaurant Quality
description: i can't wait to make this version of general tso's chicken.  a detailed write-up and the recipe i found in the february/march 2008 publication of "cooks country" magazine.  note:  in step 4, the fried chicken pieces can be held in  200 degree oven for up to 30 minutes before being added to the sauce (if held any longer, they will lose their crispness).  if the sauce is too thick in step 5, whisk in 1 tablespoon of water before adding the crispy chicken.  note #2: please note that the time's i've enter are guesstimations only and the marinading time is not included.

name: Gebna Makleyah  Egyptian Oven Fried Cheese
description: i found this recipe on the food by country website which stated that "in egypt, cheese with bread is frequently served at meals. here, oven-fried cheese is served with lemon wedges and pita triangles." you can easily vary the recipe to suit your tastebuds by adding tomatoes or other vegetables, or vary the cheese by using a traditional egyptian white cheese, such as gibna beyda, instead of crumbled feta.

name: Aunt Martha S Microwave Boiled Custard
description: i don't make too many things in the microwave, but this is an easy way to make this recipe.

name: Aunt Jennie S Favorite Pumpkin Cake
description: aunt jennie is always sharing her favorite recipes, typing them up and mailing them to friends and family unsolicited. she has been doing that for years.   i guess she was the precursor to sites like this one!

name: Pasta Primavera With Chicken And Asparagus
description: this cooking light recipe is a wonderful use for the pencil-thin late spring asparagus you find in farmer's markets in may and june. it tastes very fresh and all the ingredients come together beautifully. it has 10 ww points per serving as shown.

name: Gateau Basque  French Pastry Cream Version
description: per pierre-yves chupin in *french bistro and cafe cooking* , "there are 2 versions of *basque cake* , 1 based on cherry preserves & another on pastry cream (creme patissiere) that is always very popular." a rz search yielded several recipes for cherry preserves versions & none for the latter that i could find, so i am entering it here as he opted to do in his cookbook. (time does not include time for dough to rise). *enjoy* ! -- *edited to add* -- despite extraordinary efforts to verify & correct this recipe + 2 tries at making it by buddha, it appears the recipe may be faulted in some way. details + photos of the recipe from the cookbook can be found at http://www.recipezaar.com/bb/viewtopic.zsp?t=261947&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=30. if anyone can shed light on this prob, it would be welcomed. until that happens, i plan to try to  email the author & publisher to register a complaint. if they respond, that answer will be posted in this thread at that time. :-(

name: Pasta Salad With Chicken And Artichokes
Garlicky Spinach And White Bean Soup
description: from the chicago tribune: "given its high water content and satiety value, eating an entree of soup is a good way to control your diet, and it can help you work in lots of vegetables. in this recipe, the beans provide plenty of fiber, a key to weight management."

name: Pasta Salad With Honey Dijon Vinaigrette
description: a wonderful summer picnic salad.  delicious shell al dente pasta accented with sliced radishes, sweet green peas, olives, and moistened with a delicious honey dijon vinaigrette dressing.  the basil really brings the flavors alive.

name: Pasta Salad With Lemon Pesto Dressing
description: this is a food network recipe courtesy of rachael ray.  a wonderful picnic or potluck salad… no mayo!

name: Paskha   An Old Russian Easter Tradition
description:
sort of like a cheesecake this festive dish is an old tradition from russia. the farmer's cheese can be purchased at any store that carries traditional kosher foods. there are special molds that can be used to give it the traditional tower shape but it can also be molded in a regular kitchen colander or clay flower pots. you will need cheesecloth for this recipe.
it is so beautiful when served with kulich which is the traditional russian easter bread.
** please note that the original recipe calls for 4 cups of sugar rather than 2 cups. we just don't care for too much sugar.**

name: German Fresh Fruit Kuchen  Bread Machine
description: fresh fruit kuchen, a summertime favorite and, with the help of a bread machine, is especially easy to prepare. it makes a delicious start to a lazy summer day when you want to hurry off to the beach or another favorite activity. try it with juicy nectarines, peaches, plums or pears. the recipe calls for all-purpose flour to make the coffee cake especially light and tender. dough can be prepared in all-size bread machines.

name: Pasta Shells With Peas And Ham
description: a great homey pasta dish! recipe compliments of fast expert, amy tornquist of food & wine magazine.

name: Papaya Marinated Steak   Malay Onion Sambal
description: this recipe is great when you have left over papaya skin! grilled steak is the star of many a braai. the papaya skin is the tenderizer for the steaks and the  flesh can be saved for another recipe. the onions in the sambal are salted and then rinsed cleaned, this process softens them and removes their bitter juices. the malay makes about 1 1/2 cups. the recipe is adapted from jenna holst from a south african barbecue. make ahead: the sambal can be prepared through the first step up to 1 day ahead. steaks marinate for 1 1/2 - 2 hours.

name: Ginger And Vanilla Bean Creme Brulee
description: the subtle hint of ginger makes this dish very special and the texture is perfect.  make it the day before so that it has the proper amount of time to chill.  i have successfully swapped whole milk for half of the heavy cream.  if you want to get creative...add fresh raspberries to the bottom of the ramekin.  use a bit of raspberry jam to achor the berries down and making sure that they are placed on their sides.  carefully pour the brulee mixture and bake as directed

name: Ginger And Toffee Self Saucing Pudding
description: an oldie but a goodie.

name: Pao De Mel  Portuguese Honey Bread
description: this sweet bread is so yummy. note: you can cut the cooking time if you use two small loaf pans instead of one large one. if you use the smaller pans, bake for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

name: Papa John S Garlic Dipping Sauce
description: i love papa john's garlic sauce!! i think i could practically drink the stuff!! i found this recipe on the net, and i am posting per request. haven't tried it yet, but it sounds good!!

name: Aunt Neals Old Fashioned Tea Cakes
description: this recipe came from a gooseberry patch cookbook as requested from heather feather. it is attributed to ana kelly's(birmingham alabama)aunt cornelia.........ana kelly stated that these date back to the turn of the 20th century.

name: Gibna Wi Bateegh  Cheese And Watermelon
description: this is a breakfast appropriate dish. or even brunch. serve with warm pita. i ate this alot growing up especially on a warm day. you will be surprised to see how well the cheese and watermelon complement each other.

name: Aunt Nancy S Flaky Pastry Crust
description: a tender, flaky pie crust recipe that yields a top and bottom crust for an 8" pie.

name: Paprika Chicken With Sour Cream Gravy
description: best with a side of mashed potatoes or rice for the extra gravy!

name: German Kinder Mandarinen Bowle  Kiddie Punch
description: bowle is a popular summertime punch served in germany. this kid friendly version is alcohol free. use the straws as picks to stab at the pieces of fruit.

name: Giada S Sausage  Peppers  And Onions
description: a recipe by giada off food network.  this recipe was awesome!!!  i didn't have marsala wine so i substituted some homemade stuff.  i also substituted green peppers for red.  delicious!!!

name: Ghanaian Chicken And Peanut Butter Soup
description: this very traditional dish is intended to be served with recipe #456094. there aren't a lot of ingredients, it's not hard to make and if you like peanuts, you will like this! this is modified from a recipe from recipes for fostering. enjoy!

name: German Topping  For German Chocolate Cake
description: a lady i know makes the best german filling (for upside down german chocolate cake where the gooey bit is in the middle) in the world. i can't get enough of this stuff. makes enough to fill one 9-inch chocolate cake. this will keep for one week in the fridge.

name: Parmesan Mustard Pork  South Beach Friendly
description: i made this the other night and it was really delicious.  very moist and flovorful.  enjoy!

name: German Sausage With Mustard Caper Sauce
description: this recipe is based on a dish my husband made for me... i, ehem, forced him to help me write it down because it was so good!

name: Parsley  Olive Oil  And Garlic Sauce
description: from the "seven fires" argentinian cookbook. this pesto-like sauce is offered in many restaurants as an alternative to chimichurri or salsa criolla. use it on recipe #478140 and other grilled meats.

name: German Meatloaf  Falscher Hase   False Hare
description: this is a

name: Pasta Shells With Gorgonzola Cheese Sauce
description: here's a recipe that dh and i love.  it makes a delicious, work-night meal and is great with a green salad dressed in a simple vinaigrette, or as a side dish with a grilled steak.  the original recipe calls for salt but with the cheeses you probably won't need it - taste first, then add it if you like.

name: Pasta With Asparagus And Fried Eggs
description: the eggs make sort of an 'instant sauce' when placed on top of the pasta and asparagus. a quick, easy dinner for two from the chicago tribune's good eating section.

name: Garlic And Herb Cream Cheese Spread
description: enjoy this delicious dip or spread with your favorite crackers, crostini or wrap.

name: Paula Deen S Brown Sugar Chewies
description: this is a great bar cookie. i got rave reviews when i recently made them.

name: Garlic Lover S Dressing Or Dip
description: this is the kind of recipe you can't make too much of because you'll want to eat it with everything!

name: Pat Mccarron S Strawberry Feta Salad
description: if you love feta, feel free to add more! this is a wonderful summer salad.

name: Pat S Fab Rhubarb   Date Cake
description:
this recipe was given to me by my mum's friend pat. she'd made it to serve at their horticultural fair and i thought it was delicious! the rhubarb and dates compliment each other perfectly.
please note that if you use a larger pan then you will end up with a different textured cake from this!!

name: Garlic Herbed Roasted Red Skin Potatoes
description: these are great roasted red skin potatoes. make sure you cook them a long time until they are golden brown. usually takes about an hour for me. for the herbs i usually use rosemary, parsley, basil, and oregano. simply delicious!

name: Pati A La Rapure  Rappe Pie
description: a french-canadian potato casserole-very similar to a hash-brown casserole. comfort food. found this on the internet in response to a conversation.  i am posting for safe-keeping.

name: Garlic Chicken With Artichokes And Mushrooms
description: another from a garlic lovers cookbook, this is very very good served with rice or noodles

name: Paula Deen S  Layered Mexican Cornbread
description: from paula deen's visit on "the view" looked so yummy. haven't tried it yet, but it's paula deen!

name: Paula Deen S Chocolate Ganache Cake
description:
this is from paula deen's magazine called holiday baking from 2007.it is amazing!i love the store bought cakes that have the buttercream icing and this is just like it,plus an added bonus of ganache over the top.this will be my new birthday cake to make every year!
i didn't use buttermilk i used milk with lemon juice.for the 1/3 cup buttermilk called for i added 1 tsp of lemon juice to the milk.
prep time does not include freezer time

name: Garlic Mashed Potatoes And Cashew Gravy
description: a savory dish for the holidays. always a winner.

name: Paula Deen S Garlic Cheese Spread
description: this recipe comes from my sister-n-law who got the recipe out of one of her paula deen cookbook books. we had it over new years at their new years eve party. i just had to have the recipe. she served the spread  with stacy's pita chips.

name: Paula Deen S Hot Crab Dip
description: from nov 09 issue of good housekeeping, featuring paula deen.  there are other recipes for her crab dips on here, but this one is very quick and simple, with ingredients that i typically have on hand. i used nuefchatel cheese, and fat free miracle whip for a low-fat alternative, and the flavor didn't suffer at all.

name: Paula Deen S House Seasoning Mix
description: absolutely heavenly seasoning mix! i use it on everything. amazing flavor!

name: Paula Deen S Layered Meatball Casserole
description: another winner from paula deen! if your kids love meatballs, they should love this! feel free to assemble ahead and then freeze. when you are ready to serve, allow to thaw in the refrigerator and then cook as directed.

name: Paula Deen S Mexican Cornbread Lightened
description: yummy cornbread

name: Garlic And Hot Pepper Toasted Almonds
description: these are great as a host gift or holiday gift in an clean mason jar with nice ribbon, or try them as a low fuss pre-dinner snack. developed for the almond board of california by trish magwood, author of james beard award winning cookbook  ‘dish entertains’,

name: Garlic And Herb Stuffed Baked Potatoes
description: these are so easy and yummy. they can be made ahead of time and refrigerated. just bake and serve with your favorite steak.

name: Garlic Lovers Easy  Peasy Chickpea Dip
description: a fast dip, great for last minute company.  it improves while it sits, but it doesn't need meld time to be ready to serve right away.  this recipe was created through improvising on a couple of recipes i found online. ** garlic lovers only!**  the fresh garlic is the prominent flavor in the dip. (if you can't get old bay seasoning in your area, you might want to add some cayenne for a little kick.)

name: Garlic Mashed Winter Vegetables  Ww Core
description: tired of mashed potatoes?  this offers a delicious change of pace with a tasty blend of flavors and textures.

name: Garlicky Grilled Beef Tenderloin With Herbs
description: this is a recipe i cooked for my birthday.  it was my very first tenderloin on the grill.  the recipe was very easy.  and it got rave reviews at the party.  i actually scaled the recipe down for just 1 lb of tenderloin, but i'm including the whole recipe here.  i got the recipe online from food & wine.  i believe they used fresh herbs in the original recipe.  i didn't have any fresh on hand, but i had a ton of dried, so i used that and it was still wonderful.  i have changed the recipe to reflect my use of dried herbs.

name: Pasta With Lemon  Asparagus And Cheese
description: recipe source: prevention (april 2009)

name: Aunt Hazel S Chocolate Marshmallow Dessert
description: this recipe is one of my favorite make ahead desserts but ancient-i got it via my mother from an aunt-i think it is probably well over 50 years old.  whenever they invented the marshmallow...  when did they invent the marshmallow?

name: Garlic Stuffed Pork Roast With Glaze
description: for even more flavor after seasoning the roast cover and refrigerate overnight -- for best results use a meat thermometor for this, stuff the roast with as many cloves as desired, i say the more the better! --- note if you prefer lots of glaze, use 1 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons cornstarch, 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup water and 1/4 cup soy sauce, cook as directed.

name: Pasta With Chickpeas And Garlic Sauce
description: another great veggie pasta dish from cooking light magazine.

name: Garlic Potato Chip Chicken For 2
description: baked chicken.

name: Pasta With Egg  Salt  And Garlic
description:
another very simple italian recipe, like recipe  #154384: piquant, economical, absurdly easy, unusual, and totally, irrepressibly authentic.
you can add all sorts of things: i like beans, cubed boiled potatoes, or rosemary.

name: Pasta With Garlic And Parmesan Spinach
description: great and easy recipe from donna hay's 'flavors'.

name: Garlic Balsamic And Rosemary Roasted Potatoes
description: as the potatoes cook, the balsamic vinegar caramelizes making the potatoes sticky and mouthwatering. roasted chicken would be a perfect accompaniment to these delicious roasted potatoes. i have served mine with steak and they are to die for.  super easy.  the recipe is from www.littlepotatoes.com which was on the bag of potatoes i bought.

name: Aunt Eileen S Sauce Pan Brownies
description: aunt eileen gave this recipe to my mom and we made it and it was delicious.  you can melt the chocolate and butter in the microwave but be careful not to burn it.  you can also use nuts instead of chocolate chips.  or you can use both!!

name: Pasta With Tomatoes  Peas And Cream
description: a delicious, quick and easy, one pot meal that the family loves. you can saute shrimp or italian sausage to go with this if you like to add meat.

name: Aunt Bev S   Weird  Hot Dogs
description: i went camping with my uncle dick and aunt bev last summer and was introduced to this recipe.  my aunt bev was raised by 'daddy' (who has the most fantastic southern drawl you will ever hear) and her mom (heaven now has a perfect angel looking down on all of us. )  this is how her family ate their hot dogs.  when my uncle first told me about them i looked at him and said, "there is no way those can be good!  that's crazy!"  guess what was for dinner that night?  aunt bev's "weird" hot dogs.  because i love her and didn't want to offend her, i tried them.  love 'em!  this is definitely a recipe for someone who is willing to try different things. ;)

name: Aunt Ada S Carrot Coconut Cake
description: ever since i joined zaar i wanted to post this wonderful, never-fails-to-impress recipe. i know there are dozens of carrot cake recipes on zaar, but i haven't come across one exactly like this one. it bakes perfectly at any altitude and is scrumptious. the metric measures are the ones i use.

name: Garlic Spaghetti With Pan Fried Vegetables
description:
a delicious, garlicky vegetarian spaghetti loaded with delicious pan-fried vegetables in extra-virgin olive oil.
if you want a lighter, more wholesome meal, omit the potatoes and add chopped spinach.

name: Pasta With Pesto And Poached Chicken
description: lovely creamy chicken salad, quick and easy! from b h & g

name: Garlic Shrimp And Peas With Linguine
description: toss lemony shrimp in a flavorful garlic and butter sauce and serve with linguine and peas.

name: Pasta With Spinach  Feta And Olives
description: mediterranean-inspired salad served warm. also delicious cold. don't add salt - the feta, olives and capers provide plenty. a short sturdy pasta works best such as bowties, shells, elbows.

name: Pasta With Tomato  Spinach  And Mozzarella
description: this recipe is quick and easy, but most of all it is healthy!  enjoy!

name: Pensacola Grilled Chicken  Spicy And Sweet
description: tasty low-fat grilled chicken dish and great for an informal barbecue with friends. i adapted this recipe from a magazine ad.

name: Penzey S Rutabaga And Carrot Bake
description: from the 2003 penzey's holiday catalog.

name: Bbq Meatballs  Courtesy Of Pioneer Woman
description:
these really are so delicious, folks. they’re almost like little “meatloaf balls”, with a lot more flavorful surface area than a big slice of meatloaf. and the sauce is just a classic sweet/sour ketchup concoction and it makes you think of grandma. my kids love this dish, which is a miracle. and they’re delicious warmed up the next day and placed on a toasted sandwich bun with melted mozzarella on top. yikes.
*note that these meatballs are not in the same category of regular italian meatballs that would go in spaghetti and meatballs—those have more of a breadcrumb/parsley/parmesan flair. these are more in the comfort food/meatloaf category. if you’d like to serve them with pasta, regular egg noodles tossed in a tiny bit of melted butter would be divine.

name: Fettuccini With Shiitake And Garlic Butter
description: this is from my 365 one dish meals cookbook

name: Filet Mignon With Cherry Balsamic Reduction
description: while visiting los angeles, i found this recipe on a card that you can pick up at the local grocers.  this particular combination of meat and fruit had me intrigued so i brought it back for use at some later point.  filet mignon is pricey so this is certainly a special occasion food.  planning to serve it with roasted potatoes and maybe some nice asparagus.

name: Bean Soup  Aka Starving Student Minestrone
description: i came up with this one day when i was too sick to go to the store, so i just threw together what i had in the house. it turned out so well that i have made it again on other occasions. to make it even more nutritious, you could probably add canned vegetables as well. this is a good basic recipe that is very forgiving of experimentation.

name: Chicken  Cheese  And Avocado On Rye
description: i made this tonight to use up some stuff from the fridge, and everyone loved it! the measurements are approximate, just add amounts to suit your own tastes :)

name: Fig And Chile Glazed Pork Tenderloin
description: very simple to throw together and cooks quickly on the grill, from cooking light

name: Porcupine Meatballs Baked In Chili Sauce
description: these are full of flavor and make a wonderfully rich tomato gravy to serve over rice, mashed potatoes, or the meatballs themselves.  these are always well received and i think that they have a much better flavor than the tomato soup based sauces.

name: Pork And Pineapple Kebabs  Cooking Light
Pork And Prawn Shrimp Stir Fry
description:
a really simple stir fry, with loads of flavor and plenty of  vegetables, served with chinese noodles.

easily to  prepare ahead and so quick to put together.

name: Fettuccine With Ricotta And Dill Sauce
description: this recipe has been modified from

name: Poohrona S Low Calorie Pita Pizza
description: i made this so i could enjoy pizza without all the calories. i but pita bread that has flax, oat bran and whole wheat flour in it. you can put what ever you like on it but this is how i enjoy it. it is great for personal size. i use canned pizza sauce for convenience but you can really make it good by making your own.

name: Asian Marinade For  Fish Or Shrimp
description: i found this recipe on the internet. it was originally for tuna steaks, but i've found that it is just as delicious for catfish and other white fish fillets, and for shrimp. original recipe is for 1 pound of fish, but i think this makes enough to marinate a bit more than that. preparation time includes 20 minutes marinating time.

name: Fettuccine Pasta With Mushroom   Cashew Sauce
description: this recipe which i found in a 'healthy eating' magazine, can be a main dish or a side dish with a simple meat dish eg. grilled steak or chicken breast.  serve as soon as cooked or the sauce will thicken too much on standing and will need thinning with a splash of hot water. use more garlic if you like :) i do !!

name: Pork Chop And Wild Rice Casserole
description: this recipe was given to me by my mom when i first began cooking in law school.  it is so easy and enjoyable for all ages.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo With Shrimp   Crab Meat
description: from captain anderson's restaurant and waterfront market, panama city beach, florida.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo  Low Fat And Healthy
description: i got this recipe from a container of organic yogurt.  it looked really good. i love alfredo sauce, but it's so high in calories and fat. this looks like a possible alternative. i haven't tried it - if you try it, please review it!

name: Pork Chop  Stuffing And Apple Bake
description: i found this recipe in an old cookbook of mine and always thought it sounded kind of strange.  one night i tried it and now i always have the ingredients on hand for a quick meal. my family loves it!

name: Pork Chops   Mushrooms  Baked In Foil
description: i think this is the perfect dinner party recipe!  easy enough for a beginner cook to handle and yet really impressive!  i see no reason why you can't prepare this recipe in advance, up to the wrapping in foil stage, then refrigerate it until you're ready to cook it - perhaps adding 15 minutes to the cooking time.  you could substitute a half and half mixture of ordinary sour cream and double cream for the creme fraiche, but the creme fraiche is best and won't separate.  this dish is rich, so it only needs simple side dishes.  i serve it with potatoes anna recipe #103214 and a steamed green vegetable.  it also reheated well in the microwave the next day.  it's adapted from a delia smith recipe.

name: Filet Mignon With Lemon Parsley Butter
description: the lemon-parsley butter adds a nice twist to your next filet mignon.  from the weber cookbook

name: Pomegranate Molasses And Pine Nut Cookies
description: adapted from a recipe by kerry saretsky at serious eats http://tinyurl.com/d7b834 - she describes them as "these cookies are to die for—the texture of a crumbly-chewy chocolate chip cookie, studded with buttery pine nuts, perfumed with exotic, but sweet and familiar vanilla. then there's the flavor you just can't place off the top of your head, that tart, fruity sweetness of the pomegranate molasses. these are very special, with an upscale, artisan flavor, and comforting, addictive sweet texture. dipped in milk, they're a surprise wrapped in an everyday cookie wrapper."

name: Feta And Olives In A Jar
description: another idea for gift baskets, the feta is off course wonderful to add to salads!this works out much cheaper making it yourself then buying it.

name: First Daily Ritual  Meditation And Tea
description:
this is how i optimally start each day...

ginger steeps and releases vit c, magnesium, potassium, copper, and manganese. it is traditionally used to relieve gastrointestinal issues like gas and nausea. it is a super food because of it's high antioxidant content, anti-inflammatory properties, helping to reduce your risk of cancer, and promoting sweating (hello toxin removal!) thereby enhancing your immune system naturally...

lemons are a great source of thiamin, riboflavin, patothenic acid, iron, magnesium, vit c, b6, calcium, potassium, and copper. their high vit c content will help relieve more inflammatory conditions, and reduce risk of cancer. 

add peace and quiet, maybe a few deep breathes (see note) and enjoy!

name: Poached Eggs With Mushrooms And Tomatoes
description: recipe from real simple magazine, feb 2010.  great fast vegetarian entree!  next time i am going to throw some spinach in with them mushrooms to boost the green factor :)

name: Fish Fillets With Pineapple Jalapeo Salsa
description: recipe from the huffington post.

name: Poached Salmon W Dill Sauce  Cold
description: this is great, chilled or room temp it is always a hit at parties, and it's great for a dinner too

name: Poached Salmon With Dill Yogurt Sauce
description: this 30 minute meal is easily prepared. do not remove the skin before poaching or the fish might fall apart during the cooking process. the vegetables in the pot can be served alongside the fish or discarded. buttered egg noodles with a little chopped parsley are good, on the side. and, as i suggest with all my recipes which call for wine, use a good, drinkable wine.
