description: easy and oh so good, this will satisfy your taste buds! adapted from rachael ray's big orange book cookbook.

name: Grilled Caribbean Chicken Breasts
description: another gem adapted from the national chicken council, this recipe uses spices and flavors of the topical caribbean to liven up the humble (and often bland) chicken breasts.  as warm weather approaches in the northern hemisphere, this will be a hit at the family bbq.

name: Barbecued Sesame  Chicken Breasts
description: a delightfully different marinade for chicken breasts.

name: Chili Sauce  Low Fat
description: in the small city where my grandma was from, more than half the ladies that lived there used this recipe. it is a fabulous recipe! cook time is an estimate.

name: Chili Rub For Pork
description: this recipe has just enough spice to give it a kick. my son actually did the prep work. the original recipe was for pork chops but it's so good you could use it for any meat. my husband and kids really enjoyed this one. recipe found in candian living.

name: Barbecued Recipes Grilled Shrimp
description: barbecue recipes, formerly patio recipes revised january, 1985

name: Chili Pesto Chicken Pasta
description: my brother made this for my kids one day when they were visiting him. it has become my dd favourite meal. the sausage adds enough spicy flavour to this pasta dish.

name: Chili Macaroni And Cheese
description: from a local extension cookbook

name: Grilled Cheesy Apple Sandwiches
description: this is a yummy sandwich inspired by my love of cheddar apple pie. the grilling instructions are based on the method my sister and i always use for grilled sandwiches because we're too inept to do it in a skillet.

name: Grilled Chicken   Shish Taouk
description: i found this recipe in a lebanese cook book by hussien dekmak.  really, really delicious.  nice and easy to prepare.  i served them on brown rice with grilled vegetables.  they would also go nice with a fresh salad.

name: Chili Con Carne Soup
description: my hubby loves chili con carne. this is a little twist on an old classic..... each serve will cost you ww (aus) 4 points.

name: Grilled Chicken Pan Bagnat
description: chicken spin on the traditional sandwich. to save time the lemon olive oil vinaigrette doubles as a marinade. you can serve the sandwich immediately or let it marinate.

name: Chili Chicken With Asparagus
description: very tasty meal.

name: Green Lime Shrimp   Mexico
description: a quick way to make shrimp. use a hot or mild chile.

name: Chinese Orange Donut Holes
description: i just saw sunny anderson make these on cooking for real and had to post this recipe! so easy, quick and tasty! you could change this up with a little ground ginger or lemon zest mixed in with the sugar. have fun! :)

name: Ham And Cheese Muffins
description:
the best breakfast muffins ever! they made them at the sandwich shop my mom worked at when i was little. i started to make them at my work, not only were the staff hooked, but the customers too. :) 
you can use on of those small cooked hams you find by the bacon in the stores (?sorry, dont know how else to describe it). cube the ham and cheese into dice sized chunks.

name: Chocolate And Hazelnut Biscotti
description: yummy guilt-free treat! these are delicious dipped in coffee, hot chocolate, or warm milk. from http://cafefernando.com/chocolate-and-hazelnut-biscotti

name: Chocolate Belton Cream Pie
description: this is actually a cake--a chocolate version of boston cream pie, i created for our daughter-in-law: sure to please any chocoholic!! so inexpensive and easy to make!! layers of rich chocolaty cake, with chocolate pudding in between, covered entirely in chocolate fudge glaze.  delightful, cool way to end a summer meal.

name: Chocolate Bar Cake Filling
description: if you want to make your cakes extra special, this is a great chocolate filling recipe, this filling is very light, and not too sweet...great to use for any cake.

name: Chocolate Banana Protein Smoothie
description:
this is a shake i drink a lot during the school year, when i am too busy and frazzled to find the time to cook. it is very filling and really helps me meet my protein needs for the day.

it isn't terribly sweet. if you are used to sweet shakes, i'd recommend adding a bit of sugar to the mix. the bananas add some natural sweetness.

name: Greek Meatloaf With Feta
description: oregano, garlic and feta cheese brings a ho-hum dish to new heights.  serve with lemon potatoes and greek salad.

name: Chocolate Banana Bread Pudding
description: toronto pastry chef anna olsen includes this in her own christmas eve traditions! i like it because its actually a "double duty" recipe ........ i used half the banana bread on its own, then used the other half to make half the bread pudding. you could use your own favourite banana bread recipe - or even a store bought banana bread if you're really pushed for time. i served it warm with frozen vanilla yogurt but i actually preferred it the next day at room temperature.

name: Chocolate Anise Cookies Biscotti
description: this has a mild anise flavor and is not as hard as some biscotti. recipe from the foodnetwork and giada de laurentiis.

name: Chocolate And Coconut Pie
description: for all chocolate lovers! this is the best pie you will ever eat. top a warm piece of this pie with a spoonful of vanilla ice cream and you will think you have died and gone to heaven.....

name: Chocolate Blackberry Breakfast Smoothie
description: based on a recipe from john la puma, m.d.’s book, chefmd’s big book of culinary medicine. frozen blackberries give this quick shake a thick texture and gorgeous purple color. you may substitute organic chocolate milk, such as horizon brand, for the soy chocolate milk. organic soft tofu may replace the silken tofu. add the optional agave nectar or dark honey for additional sweetness.

name: Chocolate And Apple Crumble
description: this is a delicious hot pudding and a bit of a twist on your usual apple crumble. the ginger really adds an interesting, warming flavour. serve with vanilla ice cream or custard, or if you're feeling really decadent; chocolate custard.

name: Greek Orzo And Broccoli
description: the warm side dish delivers strong feta and olive flavors while red pepper flakes add a little spice. sometimes i add some diced red bell pepper to add color, but i really prefer it without the red bell pepper.  the original idea for this recipe came from a recipe on allrecipes, but i've added some things and made others optional.

name: Greek Orzo Stuffed Peppers
description: recipe from eating well magazine, march/april 2009.  this is a low calorie option and i love that it's cooked in micro and stovetop. . .no heating up the house with the oven!

name: Bars To The Stars
description: this recipe came from a calendar-like cookbook, from wisconsin electric.  the cook who submitted the recipe said it belonged to her aunt who was a caterer.  one of her clients was capt. kangaroo!  note:  cook time includes chill time.

name: Chocolate   Date Pudding Cake
description: recipe courtesy tyler florence.  food 911 - episode - not too sweet to eat.  i haven't yet made this but watched the episode & was intrigued by the use of dates & chocolate in a low fat, fiber rich dessert.  substituting splenda granular for some/all of the sugar would make this almost guilt free!

name: Chocolate   Olive Oil Mousse
description: this delicious, easy, and pareve mousse recipe was printed in the "new york times" (march 2007) and adapted from "dulce lo vivas: la reposteria sefardi," ("live sweet: the sefardi bakery") by ana bensadón.  it can also be baked as a cake (at 350f for about 50 minutes).  mousse must be chilled for 24 hours.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
description: from the cookbook 365 ways to cook chicken. it doesn't say which part of the chicken to use, so my suggestion is to base the chicken part on other similar recipes.

name: Chocolate Body Break Cake
description:
this is from the programm body break a low fat cake...easy and its good...now if you frost or whatever, you will increase the fat contents... or use a 7 minutes frosting...fat content for this cake as recipe is 2.5 grams per three layer slice including the fill. oh yes this rises high...

yes the cocoa amount of 1 1/2 cups is correct...

name: Greek Poppy Seed Strivers
description: these are sooo good, i practically ate all the dough before i had a chance to bake them. my mom (who is initially from england) said they taste kinda like marzipan, of course i've never tried marzipan so i can't vouch for that, but they're really good. they have a nice buttery nutty taste, which is great with mocha!

name: Greek Chicken Pita Salad
description: this makes a great lunch, plan ahead, the chicken mixture has to stay in the fridge for 2 or more hours. prep time includes chilling time.

name: Greek Almond Shortbread Circles
description: rose water, a distillation made from rose petals, blesses these cookies with a distinctive fragrant, floral flavor.

name: Basboosa   Easy Semolina Cake
description: this has been a favorite dessert in many middle eastern and north african countries- this is my mother's recipe. it's very simple and easy to remember.

name: Biscuit  Topped Hamburger Stew
description: different twist on the old stew recipe

name: Chocolate Butterfinger Ice Cream
description: i found butterfingers chocolate bars for sale on a recent holiday to queensland, then came home to hunt on zaar for a worthy way to use them.  what i settled on was a combination of several recipes i found on several sites.  we were both really impressed with how it came out, so thought i'd share with my zaar friends.  this would also work well with violet crumble or other chocolate candy bars.

name: Chocolate Buttercrunch Coffee Cake
description: from the 2006 robin hood baking festival booklet.  moist and delicious with chocolate and toffee in every bite!

name: Greek Butter Bean Salad
description: this is a lovely greek style salad that my favourite greek friend makes. it's substantial enough to serve as a main course with warm pita and a nice glass of chilled white wine.

name: Greek Chicken Salad Pitas
description: these pita sandwiches are packed with flavor. they are great to serve for guests for a nice lunch. you can often buy kalamata olives from the deli section of the grocery store, the gourmet food case, or with the regular olives. if you need to save time, buy precooked, cubed chicken.

name: Chocolate Breakfast Taco  Crepes
description: a very light taco or crepe good for breakfast or for dessert.  cooking time includes two hours for the batter to 'stand.'

name: Bartender S Root Beer
description: from hawaiian cocktails, this sounds good.

name: Greek Chicken With Orzo
description:
this tastes of summer... really nice served with a glass (or two) of red wine and a crisp salad.
you need to use the ripest, juiciest reddest tomatoes you can find, so if only anemic looking toms are on hand, use a can of chopped tomatoes instead.
don't be tempted to use chicken breasts instead, as it's the chicken juices that flavour the pasta so well.
cooking time includes 2 hours marinading

name: Greek Cold Lentil Salad
description: lentils are very much enjoyed in greece and are often combined with pasta or rice or eaten cold in simple summer salads. cooking time is marinating time.

name: Chocolate Brownie Spoon Bread
description: this cake is cooked in a cast iron skillet. it comes out moist and with a crispy crust. a martha stewart recipe.

name: Greek Feta Cheese Souffls
description: a nice feta cheese souffle. serve with chablis, chenin blanc or beaujolais wine. enjoy

name: Greek Feta Crescent Triangles
description: source: pillsbury

name: Chocolate   Peanut Butter Fudge
description: this is so good. sometimes i press roasted peanuts into the soft fudge before it sets to give it that extra

name: Green Fennel Seeds Tea
description: another herbal tea preparation...yet another twist in sobriety!

name: Barley And Corn Relish
description: this is a fresh and tasty relish that can be served with grilled burgers, steaks or chicken. we enjoyed it with grilled chicken and vegetables! cooking time also includes the time for chilling in the refrigerator.made for rsc #10.

name: Barley And Kielbasa Pilaf
description: a hearty one-dish meal for early fall cooking.  this dish is made a little healthier by using barley, instead of rice, as the grain.

name: Chinese Style Skewered Chicken
description: chinese style skewered chicken

name: Green Bean Stuffed Portabellas
description: this recipe was adapted from a recipe made by sandra lee of semi-homemade cooking. this is a great way to use up leftover green bean casserole.

name: Chinese Style Fried Chicken
description: this is a great recipe for fried chicken to use in orange or lemon chicken. it’s not super greasy and it tastes great even cold. thanks pops! great with my orange chicken sauce,  recipe #381956.

name: Green Beans  N Fennel
description: i love the subtle flavor of fennel. the tomatoe sauce gives eye appealing color. quick & easy

name: Green Beans And Beef
description: my mother came up with this savory dish in the  early 1950s when the budget was tight, but there were a lot of green beans in the garden.  when times were really tough, she increased the beans and decreased the beef.  since then, the whole family looks forward to green bean season, because this is just plain old good food.  serve with garlic bread or homemade biscuits.

name: Green Beans German Style
description: this is a wonderful dish and so easy to make. wonderful for potluck

name: Chinese Style Barbecued Chicken
description: 365 easy low calorie recipes

name: Chinese Stir Fried Cabbage
description: try this dish as a great accompaniment to roast pork.

name: Green Beans With Herbs
description: this is a simple way to serve garden green beans with summer herbs. adapted from new mexico magazine (march 2004)

name: Green Chile Tortilla Pinwheels
description: a great dish to take to your next pot luck, or serve as an appetizer at your next party. not too spicy, and very addicting.

name: Green Death Tuna Sandwich
description: here's an original of mine...

name: Chinese Pork With Shallots
description: tender pieces of pork in a tasty sauce.

name: Chinese Tea Leaf Eggs
description: one of my favorite dishes combines hard-boiled eggs with the subtle flavor of anise and the deep brown hues of black tea and soy. the cracked patterns from the broken shells make these quite attractive! i eat these sliced in quarters and chilled as a side dish, appetizer, or snack.

name: Chinese Style Tofu  Sauce
description: definitely a comfort food, this can be the main course with rice rather than just a 'sauce' to put over the rice! if you're desperate and without cashew or sesame butter, try experimenting with tahini and/or peanut butter. note: i have no idea how long it takes to chop the vegetables, and i realize the minutes don't add up to the total cook time. what can i say, i'm slow...but i sure can cook!

name: Greek Salad For 2
description: i know...true greek salad does not have lettuce in it, but this one does.  the dressing is simple and is what makes this special.

name: Chipotle Honey Mixed Nuts
description: another variation to "fancy up" nuts to serve at your next party.

name: Greek Squash Pita  Savoury
description: this ia another pita (pie) recipe using pumpkin (or any squash - zucchini is great!) as a filling. for all familiar with spanakopita, please try this variation for something satisfyingly different.

name: Chipotle S Guacamole Recipe
description: i'm told this is the guacamole from chipotle's. i'm also told that haas avocados are the key, but i really have no idea if that's a set in stone fact. i've never had chipotle's guacamole, as there are none near me, but i have had this, and i sure do like it, no matter who came up with it.

name: Greek Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: from everyday food

name: Greek Style Pork Chops
description: these usually come out very tender.  i recommend using a nonstick pan so all the good stuff sticks to the chop instead of the pan.  the amount of the ingredients is a guess, since i usually eyeball it, but don't be scared to use a healthy dose of the salt and lemon juice.

name: Biscuit Mix Pizza Dough
description: this is an easy way to make your own pizza dough and it comes out really good. i am only including the prep time because depending on the thickness of your pizza or if you use for stromboli, etc. your cook time will vary.

name: Greek Tomato Penne Pasta
description:
yummmm... delicious.
p.s. leave out the feta cheese for a much lower calorie meal! these are also pretty big servings for 4...

name: Greek Egyptian Beef Stew
description: i love this recipe, as does my family. it can be served with pasta, but usually i serve it as a stand alone. this recipe came from the internet, but i can't seem to remember where i got it. if you have picky eaters who will not eat onions, half the onions, then quarter them so the pieces are large enough to pick out (though my two year old thinks they are noodles in this recipe). they are very important in the flavoring.

name: Green Bean Fiesta Casserole
description: a friend of mine gave me this recipe - it gives an extra kick to the regular green bean casserole. everyone seems to enjoy the variation!

name: Biscuit Stuffing Pork Chops
description: this is from a pillsbury cookbook of bake-off favorites. it was a 1971 finalist. i have often reduced the recipe to 2 or 3 pork chops (and kept the "stuffing" amount the same). i found that butermilk-type biscuits work better than the layer-type. also, most cream soups (mushroom or celery) can be subbed for the cream of chicken. this is hearty main dish that can paired with a vegetable side and fresh fruit for a complete meal.***editted to add that i have tried the recipe using boneless, skinless chicken breasts instead of the pork chops.  yum!!  i did add a bit of chicken broth to the soup mixture prior to pouring it over the chicken, though.  i thought that the chicken wouldn't release as much liquid as the chops did.  it was a great meal.

name: Green Apple Salsa Fresca
description:
note: a reviewer mentioned the apples turning brown.  see note at end of instructions for preventing this.
i adopted this recipe.  i have cleaned up the ingredients list.  the original poster gave this description:
serve chilled with tortilla chips. excellent served with salmon, pork or lamb. (if desired, warm the salsa quickly in a saute pan before spooning over meat or fish.)

name: Chipotle Black Bean Salsa
description: i got this "in a hurry" salsa recipe from the mccormick's website.  the chipotle chile powder that i use is pretty hot and it is not mccormick's, so i might scale the powder back a little next time.  brought this to a party and it was eaten in a hurry.  because it requires very little chopping, it was ready quickly.  i easily doubled the recipe with good results.  prep time does not include 30 minutes in the fridge.

name: Green Bean   Fig Salad
description:
green beans and figs come together to form a salad leans itself well to backyard barbeque. 
chill time is not included.

name: Chip S Grilled Bluefish
description: nothing like fresh caught blues on a cape cod summer day. this recipe comes from our son chip who loves to fish, he says it comes from someone at his work who is portuguese. it would work with other types of fish too but bluefish is the best. don't worry about the mayonnaise, it will completely disappear. it's easy to prepare and best of all, easy to clean up.

name: Barbecued Black Eyed Peas
description:
a fantastic alternative to the ho-hum baked beans served at bbqs.
this tasty side can be served hot at the bbq or cold as a salad type dish.

really good the day after. just add some more liquid and warm slowly, covered.

black eyes have a natural smoky flavour and  go really well with bbq or just try as a side dish with whatever!
i have had this recipe for about 30 years and just love it when i rediscover the wonderful blend of tastes.
for best results, do not use canned black eyes - although, speed may require that you do... the taste won't be the same.

well worth the effort of soaking and preparing.

time of preparation does not include soaking time.

name: Grilled Flank Steak Sandwich
description: not your everyday steak sandwich. needs to marinate overnight. from food and wine 2001.

name: Chickpea Pb J  Blondies
description: whhhhhhat?!  surprisingly delicious, a great way to use chickpeas in a non-savoury manner!

name: Chicken Souiza Cornbread Bake
description: this is one of our favorties and is a great crowd pleaser!

name: Chicken Spiedino   Spiedies   Speedies
description: posted in response to a forum discussion courtesy of olive garden. marinating time not included in prep time.

name: Chicken Spicy Asian Style
description: this is a classic in my family, so i thought i would share it here.

name: Grown Up Kool Aid
description: this is kool aid for grown ups so make it after the kids go to bed!

name: Chicken Sour Cream Enchiladas
description: i have used this recipe for years.  i will usually modify it using different cheeses like asadero, queso fresco or pepper jack.

name: Guacamol Eh La Bas
description: lousiana is after all, only a hop, skip and a jump away from mexico...my little invention.

name: Black Bean Chipotle Dip
description: this is a delicious black bean dip, healthy and made with good carbs.  so good you may want to double the batch!

name: Chicken Seasoning  Spice Mix
description: i was grilling chicken and didn't want to take out all kinds of bottles and jars to season the chicken on the grill, so decided to mix everything together in one handy jar to carry with me.  it was very tasty and much better then any store bought seasoning salts or mixes.  i wanted to remember it so i could make it again so i am posting it now.

name: Ground Lamb With Peas
description: fans of indian cuisine should enjoy this flavorful dish. it's quick, delicious, and colorful.

name: Chicken Scarpariello   Country Style
description: "fuggeddaboutit!" a favorite dish of the wiseguys. make this for dinner and, ba-da-bing, you're ready for an evening with the sopranos. this is one of my all-time favorite italian-american chicken recipes. be sure to serve some crusty bread to sop up the sauce.

name: Guasacaca   Guacamole From Venezuela
description:
venezuelans have their own version of guacamole called guasacaca. it's more of an avocado relish, and is made with vinegar instead of lime juice, and lots of garlic. it's often served with fried plantain and yucca for dipping.  there are many variations of guasacaca - some have tomato, some have hot chile peppers, and some are made with green peppers rather than avocado. some people seem to prefer it as a salsa, with the ingredients chopped and mixed together, while others blend it until it's very smooth.
serve guasacaca with tortilla chips, fried plantains, and especially with grilled steaks and chicken.

name: Bananas Foster Cheesecake Squares
description: i had this at a get together this weekend. it was really good and had to have the recipe.

name: Chicken Sausage Stuffed Peppers
description: i was wanting to try something new and this was a big hit with my family.... including my 3 kids!

name: Guilt Free Pumpkin Pudding
description: this is actually a pumpkin pie recipe that has been passed down over several generations. i love pumpkin pie but not the calories so omitted the pie crust, adjusted the type of milk used, and replaced the sugar for splenda. if you don't mind the extra calories just use heavy cream, and use 2/3 cup sugar instead of the splenda. i hope you enjoy this.

name: Chicken Satay Noodle Soup
description:
found this recipe in everyday with rachael ray april/2008.
posted for safe keeping :)

name: Ground Turkey Lettuce Wraps
description: explosions of tastes make this a wonderful twist on our old favorite appetizer. actually, we make a meal out of this! enjoy.

name: Bananas On The Barbie
description: a nice, sweet treat to end the bbq meal. 1/2 banana per serving.

name: Chicken Satay In Pita
description: a great brown-bag sandwich that is easy to make and a delight to the taste buds. i package everything seperately. at work i heat the satay in the microwave, then assemble. sure beats the heck out of boring pb&j.

name: Chicken Thighs And Orzo
description: while searching my "archives"  (read - box in the back of the pantry) for zaar world tour ii recipes, i ran across this gem that was torn out of bhg, sepember 2004 edition.  sounds italian to me.

name: Grilled Szechuan Pork Chops
description: another recipe i found floating around on paper...been wanting to try it...recipe says to cook it on a kettle-style grill...(note) but i think you could cook it on a george foreman grill or even a cast iron grill...cooking time does not include marinating time...

name: Grilled Tandoori Style Chicken
description: from licence to grill rob rainford.  it was very good.

name: Chicken Tikka Lunch Box
description: got this from a friend, sounds healthy

name: Bar B Que Sauce
description: another great recipe from my little red book--fireman's fire house cook book.  i have used this barbecue sauce for everything--even take a bottle with us on vacation.  it tastes great on everything--any meat--you will love this one.  you also can make it as mild or hot as you like--a wonderful sauce.

name: Chicken Thighs With Tomatoes
description: we enjoyed this simple dish with just some salad. recipe source: local newspaper

name: Chicken Thighs With Artichokes
description: when our supermarket has really good sales on meat and poultry i buy it in bulk and store it in our freezer chest.  this is a good recipe to use for chicken thighs.

name: Grilled Wild Boar Chops
description: lemon and rosemary play with the rich leaness of wild boar.  serve with farmgirl's mushroom ragout and roasted veggie-fruit medley.

name: Ground Chicken Skillet Dinner
description: this is a quick dinner for those rushed evening dinners.  you can chop all the ingredients the night before to save time.

name: Grilled Zucchini Parmesan Sandwiches
description: makes 4 open-faced sandwiches. be sure to get the nice heavy whole-grain bread, not the airy brown colored "wheat" bread! from "cooking a la heart"- delicious heart healthy recipes from the mankato heart health program, 1988.

name: Chicken Taco And Rice
description: this is an easy meal to put together and is a long time favorite in out home. it makes plenty and the leftovers are the best part.

name: Banff Pasta   Vegetarian   Canadian
description:
while on a skiing vacation to banff, canada we ate at a small restaurant - i think coyote cafe was the name - i ordered a wonderful dish of pasta...and this recipe is very close to the dish i had in banff.

i used spaghetti, you could use any pasta you prefer.  if you are a vegan you could omit the cheese.

this could be a side-dish or an entree.  use the best quality goat or feta cheese.

name: Ground Beef   Sauerkraut Soup
description: i had leftover sauerkraut and one pound of ground beef in my refrigerator so i did a search and found this one. it's originally a south beach recipe.

name: Ground Beef Chow Mein
description: reminds me of my childhood.

name: Chicken Stock Using Carcass
description: a good way to make stock from a left-over chicken carcass if you've diced it up for other cuts but some meat is remaining.

name: Guinness And Cheese Soup
description: beer - it's not just for drinking any more!

name: Black Bean Quinoa Soup
description: this was adapted from a recipe on drfuhrman.com. i simplified the instructions to make it easier to prepare…..for each can of low sodium broth, i substitute 2 cups water, 1 tablespoon vegizest (from drfuhrman.com) and 1/8 teaspoon salt (optional)......you can reduce prep time by using frozen pre-chopped vegetables and jarred garlic.

name: Grilled Garlic Cheese Grits
description: we love grits, this is another good way to serve them. a great alternative to a baked potato when served with grilled steak or chicken. i belive this recipe could be made with instant grits.the 2 1/2 hours for refrigeration is not include in time. the recipe comes from tast of home's light and tasty.

name: Ham And Asparagus Pasta
description: here is a wonderful way to use up any left over easter ham. you can also use chicken in place of the ham.

name: Chicken Pie For Three
description: this is a not-too-difficult, very eye-pleasing recipe. i found this tasty recipe in a taste of home book and added my favorite pie crust recipe. even my husband, who hates the store-bought variety of shepherd's pies, likes this! i have written detailed instructions for the simple crust; even if you are inexperienced you can do this!

name: Chicken Piccata Pasta Toss
description: yummy

name: Halupki  Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
description: my grandmother matilda koval makes these....and they really warm you on a cold night. searve with mashed potatoes. these freeze well, and also taste better served the next day!

name: Ham   Cheese Stuffed Potatoes
description: when i was growing up, there was always a potato on the table. this is one of my mom's favorite recipes & we still fix these potatoes regularly. it's a good replacement for regular baked potaotes! this recipe calls for the potatoes to be baked in the oven to cook but you can cook them in the microwave. i have not had as much luck getting the potatoes to stay together when cooked in the microwave but you can try either way you like. the microwave is much faster, of course!

name: Ham   Swiss Crescent Braid
description: this was served at a family reunion and was deelish!  i found it on pilsbury website and wanted to share with you.  this doesn't stay around long at my house.

name: Ham And  Cheese Casserole
description: tasty

name: Ham And Barley Bake
description: a savory and filling casserole dish. serve with green salad and rolls.

name: Chicken Pineapple Stir  Fry
description: a colorful, delicious stir-fry that will have you out of the kitchen in a hurry.

name: Ham And Basil Quiche
description: i have been making this for many years.  easy, inexpensive, and delicious. my whole family loves it!

name: Ham And Broccoli Chowder
description: i joined a crockpot recipe group and this is one of the recipes that was sent to me in an email. this couldnt be simpler!

name: Ham And Broccoli Ring
description: delicious lunch or light dinner, or cut in small slices and serve as an appetizer.

name: Ham And Cheese Bake
description: this dish, made with leftover christmas ham, starred at a post-holiday brunch with friends. both adults and kids gobbled it up and came back for seconds. i'm told the recipe originally came from the side of the bisquick box, but i've increased the spices a bit and added dry mustard to the mix for more flavor. quick, easy, and a delicious use for leftover ham.

name: Banana Lemon Tea Bread
description: i always like to have some kind of quick bread or cake on hand for my kids to snack on. this one is really flavourful.

name: Ham And Cheese Macaroni
description: good use for left-over ham; kid favorite.
