description: a delicious, simple to make dessert 8) if you like custards and love coconut, this is for you!

name: Crumbed Cutlets  Very Juicy
description: we love these little cutlets. they are almost finger food, with only a mouthful or two on each bone. cooking time includes sauce.

name: Easy Strawberry Spinach Salad
description: this recipe uses bottled dressing instead of dressing from scratch.  my kids liked it better than the scratch recipe.  i also use prepackaged baby spinach. makes it easier on me!

name: Crunchy Crumb Apple Pie
description: this is a yummie alternative to an old favorite. the topping is sweet and the apples are a little tart. i posted this with a ready-to-bake pie crust, but i have found a homemade crust is always better! there are tons of apples in this pie but they cook down during baking. this is delicious topped with vanillia ice cream.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Rice Rolls
description: makes a good side-dish for just about any meat entree or a meatless main dish.

name: Crunchy Chili Onion Rings
description: modified slightly from the april 2006 bon appetit.  i found that the original quantities of milk and dry ingredients were about twice as much as needed so i halved those amounts.

name: Easy Santa Fe Tiramisu
description: i was on an rv road trip from seattle to santa fe, visiting friends in july 2000. we were invited to dinner at our friend's father's house. i certainly couldn't go empty handed, but i didn't bring any dessert recipes with me. i did have the current issue of taste of home, i hadn't read it yet, but it saved me! i found a recipe that i would be able to modify enough to make in the rv. i took it to this beautiful outdoor dinner party. every dish there was elegantly presented. until i set down my disposable roaster pan! i didn't know what to call this dessert, and hoped no one would know who brought it, and that's when i realized that the "wonderful tiramisu" everyone was raving about was mine! the name stuck, and i've made it the same way ever since  (although i usually present it in a glass trifle bowl). i'm sharing my very easy version with you here. enjoy!

name: Easy Seafood   Basil Alfredo
description: this dish is so quick to put together and simply delicious. who knew that cream cheese could contribute to such a lovely alfredo sauce? that's perhaps the best part about trying new recipes. they're constantly surprising you.

name: Easy Shepard S Pie
description: a quick meal that easily doubles or triples.  also freezes well.  experiment with different spices to your taste.  also works with ground turkey or lamb.  left over mashed potatoes make this dinner a snap.

name: Crunchy Cheddar Chicken Breasts
description: another one from the hidden valley ranch website that sounds really good

name: Crunchy Caramel Snack Mix
description: i've been making this snack mix since 1991 and have been asked for the recipe several times.

name: Crunchy Butternut Squash Fries
description: haven't got the chance to try this yet, but it looks and sounds great. would be a great appetizer  for fall! defiantly give it a try. i will update once i get a chance to try it myself.

name: Easy Smothered Pork Chops
description: i serve this at home when i dont want to have to stand over the stove a long time.  i just pop it in the oven and forget about it.  the gravy is awesome over mashed potatoes or rice.  these chops fall off the bone so you won't need a knife.

name: Easy Spaghetti And Meatballs
description: this is a very tasty dish that i've had lots of compliments on, even tho i cheat and use jarred sauce (shhh)...i think the slow simmering of the flavorful meatballs really makes this taste homemade all the way!!! this makes a lot, so i usually use the leftovers to make meatball subs.

name: Crunch In Your Lunch
description: this is for those who like both cheese and tuna fish. i find myself often craving this oddity but what can i say, it tastes good to me.

name: Easy Spinach Lasagne Rolls
description: makes super easy, hearty and healthy dinner. sometimes i like to do a combination of ricotta and cottage cheese. serve with a green salad and warm bread.

name: Easy Squeeze Honey Butter
description: could anything be simpler than this? you might to want to add cinnamon to make cinnamon honey butter.

name: Crumble Topped Mince Pies
description: i'm not good at pastry.  so this is the way i get around it.  these freeze well.

name: Cucumber Bruschetta  No Bread
description: this is a refreshing vegetarian appetizer for the warm summer months.  recipe came from first magazine and was part of their healthy avocado article.

name: Cucumber Dill Deviled Eggs
description: so delicious! even if they sound different from the norm deviled eggs, try these! can't get enough of them, my family was unsure at first but now they are a favorite.

name: Beef Casserole With Spice
description: i spent an day looking after a family members home while workmen were there to install a new security entranceway (they are away on holiday) so to keep me busy i decided to go through their cookbooks looking for some recipes to post on 'zaar.

name: Easy Layered Lasagna Casserole
description: my dh loves lasagna, but he also has no understanding about how much work it can be to make an excellent one. i found this recipe, and it certainly has a lasagna taste!

name: Easy Holiday Apple Cider
description: a great spiced cider for holiday entertaining. it was always a hit at parties in college.

name: Easy Homemade Vegetable Soup
description: this is my own version of my mom's recipe, tweaked to suit my (and my husband's) taste. we prefer this tomato broth instead of adding beef broth, but i suppose that would work, too. you can also add fresh veggies- i used canned because i always have the right combination on hand. there's nothing better than coming home on a cold day and smelling this soup!

name: Easy Hungarian Mushroom Soup
description: this was printed in a local paper here in pdx. this is an amazing soup to serve with crusty bread on a winter day. it is also a wonderful topping for rice, pasta or meat.

name: Curried Squashy Apples   Leeks
description: the title sums it all up. a lovely autumnal side dish that is very easy, delicious & healthy. a crock pot recipe that doesn't take all day! **i used frozen squash which worked great. please note that whichever brand i used - it may or may not hold true for all brands - the dice was small. the apples need to be about the same size as the squash. fresh squash probably will be ready quicker.

name: Easy Instant Ice Coffee
description: this is a wonderful simple and easy recipe for those who like ice coffee and it's so simple. i found the original recipe on allrecipes.com submitted by another user, but i tweaked all the measurements that it's a new recipe now.

name: Easy Jelly Roll Trifle
description: easy to make no-cook layered summer or anytime dessert with only four main ingredients; purchased jelly roll cakes (yellow cake with raspberry jam filling), pudding, whipped topping and fresh strawberries. you could make it with other fruit such as drained canned peaches,pears,or mandarin oranges, and vary the pudding as desired. i have also substituted the jelly rolls with chunks of angel food cake or pound cake spread with some raspberry or strawberry preserves.

name: Easy Layered Taco Pie
description: super quick using flour tortillas and made in the microwave!

name: Curried Vegetables And Couscous
description: i saw a recipe in a cook book and made a bunch of changes to my liking.  this is what i ended up with.  because cardamom is so expensive i used ground cinnamon instead. i also use extra-firm lite tofu to reduce fat.  you could probably substitute apple juice for wine.  my husband loved it. so did i.

name: Easy Layered Tomato Dip
description: great for superbowl parties.

name: Curried Shrimp With Peas
description: i whipped this up for dinner last night after a week of working many long hours. this was quick, easy and tasty. i steamed some jasmine rice in the rice cooker while i prepared this, and served this with my asian slaw. the leftovers were just as good the next day for lunch.

name: Beef Penne Pasta Casserole
description: this pasta and beef casserole is sure to become a family favorite.

name: Easy Mac And Cheese
description: this is from aunt debbie who got it from someone else.  it is about the easiest mac and cheese to be made.  my 4 year old daughter loves this.  this is about as easy as you can get.  you can add other ingredients after about 45 minutes according to my sister in law.  i like it just with cheese.

name: Easy Made Granola Bars
description: recipe modified from by cathyshambley.blogspot.com.  this is a very forgiving recipe, use whatever kind of oil you have on hand, safflower, canola, peanut, etc. and whatever nuts, dried fruits, chocolate, your family enjoys.

name: Belle Isle Iced Tea
description:
sort of the "out slummin' " version of long island iced tea, lol
cook time does not include chill time.

name: Easy Healthy Egg Toast
description: a quick breakfast dish that is low in fat, cholesterol free, high in protein, and sure to please children and adults alike. i created this recipe from the egg toast my mom used to make with butter, white bread, and eggs, simply variating it to my preferences. it tastes exactly like hers, only i feel better eating it knowing that it's good for me.

name: Easy Mexican Chicken Casserole
description: this was a throw together that actually turned out to be a really great little dish!!! good for a quick meal!

name: Bella S Almond Puff
description: my friend bella served this dessert to a bunch of us after a lunch we had today. it is absolutely delicious! different and easy to make as well. we had it as a dessert but it would be an excellent morning coffee break coffee cake, or a good addition to a brunch table.

name: Beef Sandwich Au Coke
description: this delicious recipe came from my dad's aunt, norma albers from kiester, mn. everyone loves it; even the picky little ones! it is great for a large group, and we are planning on making this for my brother's high school graduation open house in june. i hope you enjoy it!

name: Curtido  Salvadorean Pickled Coleslaw
description: this is a condiment served with almost any meal in el salvador, goes great with tamales and pupusas!

name: Curry Honey Vegetable Dip
description: taken from a regional cookbook "a taste of the ymca" of carbondale, pa. unknown year of publication.

name: Beef Salad Pocket Sandwiches
description: quick and easy (and a little different). another family favorite. great when you've got to get dinner on the table fast!

name: Curry Of Beef Zanzibar
description: what a lovely curry dish this is! it is quite yellow in color, and the sauce is smooth and velvety. it is the combination of all the spices which makes this great dish. use a good quality of curry and make it with any meat. it is frequently served with beef liver in east africa. try it with lamb or veal as a change.

name: Easy Greek Potatoes Yachni
description: the ingredients look long, but it's a classic store/cupboard sort of standby, cames from a favourite recipe book "tastes of the aegean" and is an excellent one pot, whole meal, tasty potato dish... i make double and freeze half for an easy after work dinner for those days when you want something hearty but can't really be bothered, or vegetarian potluck dinners... enjoy !

name: Easy Greek Inspired Salad
description: i've been on a real greek kick lately. then again, i've got a lot of ingredient leftovers, so what choice do i have but to be a little inventive. i've had this salad 3 days in a row and never tire of it. i love it! hope you will to! :) and it's so simple! have yet to try it with the olives, but i'm certain it would be divine!

name: Curried Vermicelli With Chickpeas
description: from "the pdq vegetarian cookbook" by donna klein. the chickpeas can be omitted if desired. if you want the dish a little milder, halve the curry powder and chili paste amounts. i used regular canola oil in place of the peanut oil and the recipe seemed to turn out fine. i didn't use the pimiento

name: Curry Chicken Pot Pie
description: this recipe was originally from alton brown on the food network.  i tweaked it to our liking...the kids love it!!!

name: Easy Grilled Shrimp Scampi
description: delicious shrimp scampi floating in a foil boat makes clean up a breeze! can be prepared ahead which makes it wonderful for those busy evenings or get togethers! the foil also makes this dish great for camping and picnics!

name: Easy Grilled Tri Tip
description: this is a quick and easy way to marinate tri-tip. this really brings out the flavor of the beef. the cooking time i noted is passive cooking time and includes the time it takes to marinate the meat.

name: Curry Chicken And Pasta
description: if you like pasta, this is a great alternative to traditional italian. this recipe is from rossipasta.com. they have all the hard to find flavored pastas (i used curry linguini). the version below was made to my liking which increased the curry and veggies. you can prepare the chicken however you like (whole cut up, boneless, grilled, smoked etc.). i had some whole smoked beer can chicken so i de-boned and cubed 1 pound.

name: Easy Ham And Noodles
description: i got this from another recipe website. very good.

name: Easy Hamburger Corn Casserole
description: this can be a do ahead casserole just pour the ingredients into a casserole dish before you do the final 20 minute simmer and then pop it into a 350f oven 25-30 minutes before serving - put some buttered crumbs on top - i like to serve it over noodles or add cooked macaroni to it for the final simmer - i treat this as a good basic casserole that is tasty as is or even better with your creative touch

name: Curried Party Snack Mix
description: this is a lighter snack mix than traditional chex mix.

name: Curried Okra With Tomato
description: if you like it hot, use as many of the hot chilies as you like, or leave them out.  with some grilled chicken or fish or shrimp, makes a very nice meal.  cooking time does not include defrosting time if you have to use frozen okra.

name: Easy Peel Boiled Eggs
description: you may need to experiment with the boil duration for the consistency of yolk you prefer, the times below are suggestions based on my own research.

name: Cucumber Salad  Turkish Cacick
description: this is a far better use for a cucumber than a lettuce salad. i have visited turkey, the country of origin for this recipie, and find that this recipie is in keeping with the great tastes that turkey has to offer in food preparation.

name: Cuisinart Recipe For Hummus
description: this came with my cuisinart!!  a nice basic recipe for hummus!  you can add any flavorings you want such as roasted red peppers, olives, etc.

name: Easy Oven Fried Potatoes
description: i can't tell you how many times i make this.  it's simple, it only has 3 ingredients, and it tastes delicious.

name: Cucumber Red Pepper Raita
description: i love this with grilled meats and pitas! my original source was womans day, but i could not resist the added garlic!!!

name: Cucumber Tomato Macaroni Salad
description: my family loves this salad! --- remember to use both mayo and salad dressing combined, the two dressings combined seem to spark up the taste, plan ahead this needs to be refrigerated overnight to blend the flavors.

name: Cucumber Slices With Onions
description: a recipe from my mother, who got it from her mother, whose grandmother came to the usa from germany.  a great many german immigrants settled in wisconsin, and this dish is from the homeland.  (at least that's what i've been told.)  refrigeration time not included in time to make.

name: Cucumber Ranch Chicken Salad
description: i serve this salad on lettuce leaves, but also love it between grainy bread for sandwiches. this is so easy, that i don't always admit the recipe. sorry, but some people just don't need to know!

name: Cupcake Princess  Vanilla Cupcakes
description: i have been searching for the perfect vanilla cupcake recipe for a long time, and i've found that most of them are dry. i finally changed a recipe and it makes the perfect vanilla cupcakes that are moist and not too dense. you can frost these cupcakes with many different types of frosting like vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, and more.

name: Beef Machaca  Taco Filling
description:
this came off a texas website.
really flavorful.
overnight marinating is needed.
you can also crock it after the browning process.
freezes well.

name: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
description: this is probably the easiest peanut butter pie recipe out there! from "simply delicious"- a cookbook comprised of herberger's employee family recipes. the recipe was in memory of a good friend and co-worker, bob brown.

name: Easy Peasy Banana Treat
description: this is an easy treat, that is really good. it could also be done on the grill......

name: Cucumber Mint Tea Sandwiches
description: a new variation on a traditional cucumber tea sandwich!

name: Easy Peasy Chicken Salad
description: i had to come up with a chicken salad recipe fast. this is easy and delicious. for the chicken i bought perdue short cuts origanal roasted chicken. the cumin gives it an 'exotic taste', so to speak. i'm guessing on the serving sizes and the cooking time

name: Cucumber Dill Shrimp Spread
description: this is a good appetizer for any party, you can even add more shimp.

name: Cumin Curry Pork Roast
description: from a supermarket recipe card that i grabbed recently from shop rite.  the recipe is described as having a middle eastern flavor.

name: Cupid S Barbecue Ribs
description: barbecue without a barbecue! i made these for my now-husband when we were still dating. love was in the air and so was the smell of these delicious ribs!

name: Curried Mashed Sweet Potatoes
description: from kraft.

name: Benihana Hibachi Chicken Rice
description: this is a copycat version of the hibachi chicken rice served at benihana. made in a pan but can be done on a flat grill like at the restaurant.

name: Easy Mexican Layered Dip
description: easy to make dip that doubles as a filling for tortillas or taco shells. can be used as a base with different ingredients added or removed for personal tastes.

name: Curried Garbanzo Beans  Chickpeas
description: this is quick and easy because it uses canned garbanzos (chickpeas).  serve with hot basmati rice and naan bread.

name: Curried Crab With Ricotta
description: this fusion dish brings together the spiciness of a crab curry with the coolness of fried ricotta cubes, delicately laced with fresh coriander. it is a one pot curry whose taste belies the easy preparation and cooking.

name: Easy Microwave Chocolate Fudge
description: this chocolate fudge is so easy and so yummy. it is made in the microwave and only takes about 5 minutes plus setting time.

name: Curried Chicken With Rice
description: this one comes from my newlywed days when i received a whole set of illustrated recipe cards. i tweaked it to suit our tastes into a very flavorsome and aromatic meal!  the rice cooks in the microwave while the chicken works in the frying pan; why--dinner will be ready before you know it--altho' you will have to listen to lots of begging (as in, "what are you making that smells so good?"  and "are we ever going to eat?").

name: Easy Moist Orange Loaf
description: i was craving banana bread but had a crisper full of oranges!  i came up with this yummy treat and please note that this is delicious sliced plain, or with a bit of cream cheese frosting on top for more of a dessert.  scrumptious!  this is good warm, but to die for after cooling down!

name: Easy Moroccan Vegetarian Stew
description: this is an easy vegetarian meal that i threw together for hubby and i one night. its super easy and oh so good!

name: Cupid S Chocolate Cake
description: i found this recipe in the taste of home magazine, it is by shelain duncan.  i made this for my husband birthday when we were first married.  i think he was trying to pull a fast one on me. i found out later that his mom always refused to make chocolate cake with white icing.  i have attempted this feat twice in our 7 years of marriage - you think i would have learned! anyways, despite my cakes end appearance, it tasted wonderful!

name: Easy Naan  Bread Machine
description: yummy indian naan bread .. goes great with curries etc .. very easy to make since the bread machine does all the work! try adding spices, or use whole wheat flour instead of white ..

name: Curried Cheese   Bacon Chicken
description: curry creamy chicken in a snap! work all day, rush home to prepare a nice meal for your family? here's a quick and easy to serve an elegant chicken dinner.

name: Curried Butternut Squash Bisque
description: a wonderful recipe given to me by a great teacher i work with.  if you like curry you'll love this!

name: Easy Orange Pecan Scones
description: easy, yummy scones. recipe comes from a bed and breakfast, i found the recipe on 1st travelers choice internet cookbook.

name: Easy Oven Barbecue Chicken
description:
i got this recipe from a 1980 regional cookbook put out by a nursing home that my wife's grandma was in. i remember grandma & the other residents putting in thier favorite recipes...grandma was an excellent cook! i
quote from the original contributor: "the meal will hold quite a long time in low oven after baking. this chicken is always moist & tender with a very special flavor.:

name: Cure All Ginger Tea
description: a healthy hot tea that doesn't make you drowsy. drink when you feel under the weather. (this recipe is from the cookbook

name: Crockery Pot Spaghetti Sauce
description: this is a great spaghetti sauce that can be cooked while you are at work, no fuss at all, but has all the flavor.  i like italian seasoning added to this also.  (1-2 tsp.)

name: Easy Thanksgiving Turkey Cookies
description:
these cookies are cute and easy!  kids love them!  fun to make!  i used the refrigerated cookie dough - but you could even buy pre-made sugar cookies and decorate them...  we took these to my kids classes for their pre-thanksgiving party and they were a huge hit!
it's probably easiest to just look at the picture to make these rather than follow my directions - but good luck!  enjoy!

name: Crispy Oven Fried Potatoes
description: yummy garlic oven fried potatoes

name: Crock Pot Chicken Provencal
description: this came from some crock pot site on the 'net. i haven't tried it, but it looks really easy and tasty. let me know how it is..

name: Crock Pot Chilie Verde
description: a great recipe that i got from a friend and have passed onto other friends. it's always a treat to make this easy to prepare dish.

name: Best Banana Bran Muffins
description: i like this recipe because it only calls for 2 large ripe bananas. often that is all i have left! this is a moist, tasty muffin.

name: Crock Pot Chicken Wings
description: my children love these wings. i like that they cook in the crock pot!

name: Crock Pot Chicken Tacos
description: these tacos are delicious and easy to make! to change things up try a beef or pork roast for delicious shredded beef/pork tacos!

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  Parmesan Rigatoni
description: from "every day with rachel ray" 11/06. sweet and short. (we didn't use the basil leaves, personal preference)instead used parsley.

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  Parmesan Stacks
description: these quick stacks of roasted eggplant slices and purchased polenta makes this dish easy to prepare. serve with a salad and french bread or bread sticks.

name: Crock Pot Chicken Pizza
description: this recipe came from another web site. very tasty meal.

name: Crock Pot Chocolate Cake
description: this is a great summer dessert because you don't heat up the kitchen from the oven.  the gooey, rich fudge sauce that rests under the cake is a bonus!  my daughter requests this over and over again....

name: Crock Pot Chicken Enchilada
description: great for reunions or potluck--always a big hit. i fix this a lot on sunday mornings for a great lunch after church.

name: Crock Pot Chicken Dinner
description: i think this came from an old toh or qc.  even with minimal ingredients and minimal prep time this was a very good crock pot meal.  chicken came out very moist and tender.  easy to toss together in the morning and come home to a complete meal.  we just added bread and butter and were set.

name: Crock Pot Chicken Chili
description: simple chicken chili.

name: Crock Pot Chicken Bbq
description: i got this recipe from an email newsletter i subscribe to.

name: Best Banana Bread Ever
description: i have made many banana bread recipes over the years....but this is by far the best ever!!! i think it must be the sour cream...it makes it so moist and yummy! i usually triple the recipe so i end up with 6 loaves - my neighbors/friends always want a loaf or two!

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  Supper Soup
description: friends of ours used to grow eggplants and loved any recipe that used eggplant. i like this recipe because i love eggplant. perfect meal in one dish.

name: Crock Pot Chinese Ribs
description: these ribs will have to be broiled firstly in the oven and then slow-cooked in a crock pot you can easily double this recipe. you can also cook these ribs on low heat in the oven. you might want to double the complete recipe, or just double the sauce ingredients....this is delicious! adjust the ginger and garlic amount to taste.

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  Caponata Spread
description: this is a wonderful and delicious antipasti or appetizer for an italian dinner that your guests will love.

name: Crock Pot Cheddar Fondue
description: cook your fondue in the crock pot, and keep it warm for the party

name: Crock Pot Fondue Italiano
description: i am compiling appetizer recipes for a 40th birthday party i am helping to organize.  i have not tried this one, but it sound interesting.

name: Besan  Chickpea Flour  Pastry
description: this is such a healthy pastry, and has a nutty savoury taste. i use it for all kinds of vegetarian pies and tarts, either as the shell, or as the pastry top/lid.

name: Eggless Microwave Chocolate Cake
description: when i was unable to use my oven for a period of time, i looked for ways to make my favourite baking recipes using the microwave. the following recipe was found on the nestle milkmaid website and i adapted it to improve the texture and taste. unlike many other eggless cakes, which taste rather bland, this is sweet and also often i find that because the egg is left out, the cake does not rise as much or is not as light or spongy as it could. however, here the aerated sode makes up for and the cake rises as much as any other cake made with eggs, sometimes ever more so make sure that your cake tin is the correct size or it will run over while baking, as mine did once when the tin was too small. if suitably decorated this delicious cake could be used for many special occasions.

name: Eggless Moist Chocolate Cake
description: easy and moist chocolate cake.  especially great for my son who has an egg allergy.

name: Crock Pot Hot Wings
description: these are really wonderful, you can add more franks or some cayenne pepper if you want to make them hotter. as is, they are pretty mild.

name: Best All Bran Muffins
description: this is my all time favorite recipe for bran muffins. you can make it as healthy as you want to! very good!

name: Best Backfin Crab Cakes
description: this was a winning recipe in the 1997 crab cook-off in maryland, my home state.

name: Best Bajan Oxtail Stew
description: i learned to make this when i was living in barbados. my friend, who is the grandson of a well known local cook in speightstown (mile and a quarter), never used measurements, so everything here is approximated to the best of my ability. feel free to play around with it, as it is hard to go wrong. you can find all the ingredients at any west indian supermarket. this is the best oxtail stew i have ever had and i consider myself quite the connoisseur. if you want to impress your west indian friends, try this delicious dish.

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  And Mozzarella
description: yummm......quick and easy.

name: Crock Pot Curried Turkey
description: this one is so easy to throw together and tastes so good. the only hastle is the side boys, so, invite your friends over for dinner, give them a drink and put them to work preparing side boys. that's why there are bar stools on the other side of the counter. in all truth, communal food preparing goes back to our prehistory, it is a great way to grow closer.

name: Crock Pot Cranberry Brisket
description: easy crock pot brisket recipe.

name: Crock Pot Corned Beef
description: i found this unbelievably simple, delicious  recipe on the internet - unfortunately, i don't remember which site it came from.  this recipe works with any size corned beef - i've just included the size i last bought to comply with 'zaar's posting requirements.  edited to incorporate suggestion in peter j's review below.

name: Crock Pot Cola Chicken
description: walk in the door and have barbecue chicken cooked and waiting. that's exactly what this tastes like...and the crock pot does the work.

name: Crock Pot Cinnamon Applesauce
description: i got this recipe from a cooking site called joyce's place. this is the first homemade applesauce i ever made. i think this recipe is very easy and yummy.

name: Eggplant  Aubergine  Almost Parmigiano
description: this is based on an iain hewitson recipe and it is a nice change from veal parmigiano. prep time takes in 15 minutes resting time.

name: Eggplant  Or Aubergine  Dip
description: not your classic baba ghanoosh but nonetheless a very tasty eggplant dip which i've adapted from a recipe in 'the australian women's weekly's tapas antipasto mezze'.  this dip tastes best if refrigerated overnight.  the overnight refrigeration time has not been included in the cooking or preparation times.  because vegetable sizes will inevitably be variable, add the olive oil sparingly until you can see how much you need to achieve the right consistency.

name: Eggplant And Zucchini Casserole
description: there can never be enough recipes for wonderful summer vegetables. with bacon and wine added for flavor, this one sounds like a winner. recipe adapted from the local electric co-op magazine.

name: Eggless Coconut Ice Cream
description: creamy ice cream with a rich coconut flavor. a sweet treat that any coconut lover would enjoy. again you could adjust this to the size of your ice cream maker.  also, the "cooking" time depends on your ice cream maker.  you could use this recipe as a basic and add other flavors such as pureed fruits

name: Best Bbq Ribs Ever
description: yes, there are alot of steps in making bbq ribs and a great sauce to go with it, and yes they are always worth the work. everyone has their own taste of what is great and what is mediocre. you just have to experiment with your sauces until you get it right. well i finally got it just about right. lol!! my boyfriend marvin liked it and he ate every bite and my picky son and his girlfriend also helped to finish what was left of the ribs. so i must have done something right this time. next time i will have to buy 8 lbs of ribs so i can have seconds.

name: Crock O  Cranberry Meatballs
description: i first had this at a graduation party. it's a sweet and sour treat - don't let the odd combination of ingredients fool you! great for potlucks.

name: Eggs In A Basket
description: these are really good with just a touch of spice to them.  the hash brown potatoes are nice and crisp and filled with a tasteful egg and cheese mixture with lots of tomatoes.  original recipe from my southern cooking book and altered to suit our taste.

name: Eggs In A Box
description: my husband served this at camp last year. a quick breakfast when you want something a little different.

name: Croatian Bbq Lamb Liver
description: lamb liver is usually regarded as meat surplus or just trash. but whoever tries lamb liver will change this unjust bias. (you can try this meal with pork or veal liver, but it is not so good). this is very simple bbq recipe.

name: Croatian Bbq Burger  Pljeskavica
description: this is similar meal like chevapchici but instead of sticks you have a whole burger. there is also little difference in ingredients.

name: Crispy Vanilla Caramel Popcorn
description: if you like you can start with pruchased light popcorn or pop your own without butter for a show time treat thats  reminiscent of the all time favorite popcorn balls. best od all you'll never know that they have been lightened.

name: Crispy Sweet Potato Casserole
description: this is a phenomenal side dish for holiday parties.  it is a family recipe. if you dont like mushy marshmallo sweet potatoes, try these and you will never go back to another recipe!

name: Crock Pot Artichoke Dip
description: this recipe can easily be doubled or tripled. it is so delicious! and quick for company. my son loves it. he was first introduced to this kind of dip at my brother's wedding reception, and just gobbled it up, so i had to come up with something like it. :)

name: Beef And Prune Tagine
description: we had this quite often during our trips to morocco. the actual recipe is one i adapted after we came home but i think it's pretty close to what you'd get in morocco if you went there on holiday. serve with rice or couscous.

name: Crispy Roasted Garlic Potatoes
description: amazing flavor and actually crispy.  yes, you read right, crispy.  not over garlicky, but a perfect blend of flavors.  thanks atk.

name: Crispy Ranch Unfried Chicken
description: very easy and juicy. from 2006 kraft food and family winter edition.

name: Beef And Pork Burgers
description: these burgers have more flavor than the all beef ones. i got the recipe from a friend and have made them a lot.

name: Crispy Parmesan Zucchini Coins
description: a real tasty way to use up zucchini or yellow squash.  even the large ones will work.  when finished the coins will be a delicious crisp brown on the outside and soft and tasty on the inside.

name: Crispy Parmesan Chicken Strips
description: this recipe came from my daughter. they are so tasty--i think it is the seasoned croutons. you can use these as an appetizer or as a meal. they are yummy!!

name: Crock Pot  Bbq Pork
description: this super simple recipe delivers big flavor!  serve on buns with slaw, or over hot toasted cornbread

name: Eggs A La Russe
description: adapted from the new york times cookbook.  you can also use 6 individual serving plates.

name: Eggplant Appetizer From Nigeria
description: posted for zwt 4. a simple spread made to eat with flat arabian bread.

name: Eggplant Parmigiana   Weight Watchers
description: eggplant parmigiana for 3 points a serving! woo-hoo!

name: Crock Pot Cashew Pork
description: pork with cashews.

name: Crock Pot Candied Chicken
description: i found this recipe when i was browsing through some cooking blogs.   it was on http://saracoloradorecipespot.blogspot.com/  she said she found it on a different website/blog but i'm not sure which one.   i'm saving it here to try it.

name: Eggplant Baked With Cheeses
description: this recipe is a specialty of italy's southern regions! preparation time does not include the hour needed for salted eggplant slices to drain.

name: Eggplant Casserole  Fatet Makdous
description: saw this made on "the chew" - recipe is from mais khoudrdaji.  the recipe uses pomegranate molasses (available at middle eastern markets) in a meat/eggplant/tomato sauce and is then covered with a delicious garlic yogurt & pine nuts.  looked absolutely wonderful.

name: Eggplant Lovers Stuffed Eggplant
description: this is a delicious ground beef and eggplant dish for eggplant lovers! i have varied this dish several times by using ground pork and also italian sausage meat either pork or chicken in place of the ground beef.

name: Crock Pot Blueberry Cobbler
description: we always make this when we do our group camping trip.  wonderful served warm topped with whipped cream.  ice cream would probably be good too.  i have also made it substituting apple pie filling for the blueberry and using spice cake mix.

name: Crock Pot Beer Brats
description: serve these along side of cabbage and noodles for a complete and easy german-style dinner!

name: Crock Pot Baked Beans
description: this recipe came from a friend of mine mbs, it's been my favorite ever since.

name: Beef And Spinach Patties
description: this comes from sunset's light ways with beef, lamb and pork cookbook.

name: Crock Pot Beef Stroganoff
description: i got this recipe from one of my bosses and she got it out of a crock pot recipe book. this is so easy and tastes fantastic! i have served this for friends and relatives alike and am always asked for the recipe.

name: Crock Pot Beef Burgundy
description: a great beef and noodles dish, so easy to prepare in your crockpot. the beef gets soooo tender from the long cooking process. very good!

name: Crock Pot Barbecued Ribs
description: as easy as can be and they come out so tender and delicious! not sure how many servings in the whole recipe. i usually halve the recipe and there definitely are leftovers when serving only two people. although i haven't tried it, you probably could easily make pulled pork sandwiches from this.

name: Crock Pot Barbecue Steak
description: this is a tasty barbecue steak that's made in the crock pot.

name: Eggs   Caramelized Onion Appetizer
description: this is served warm and is everyone's favorite. when someone eats this for the first time they look and think "eggs?" especially if they're not an egg salad fan (which i am absolutely not) but they eat it and then they want the recipe, it's so good "so try it, try it, it's not green eggs and ham!".

name: Crock Pot Italian Beef
description: yummy stuff here, and easy to boot! another family favorite.

name: Crock Pot Kalua Pork
description: one of our favorite things at our local hawaiian mix plate!  prep time includes the sitting overnight in the fridge.  this definitely isn't a "quick" recipe but it is worth the wait.

name: Easy Toffee Squares  Candy
description: nice texture, not too sticky and not too hard.  saved this recipe from home ec a long time ago.

name: Crock Pot Waikiki Chicken
description: quick week night meal

name: Easy  Real Tartar Sauce
description: i was astounded that not one recipe for tartar sauce on 'zaar actually contained cream of tartar. this is a basic version; add anything you like in your tartar sauce to the base, such as lemon juice, capers, or dill. tartar sauce is great with just about any fried fish dish.

name: Easy Does It Spaghetti
description: a crock pot favorite! :)

name: Easy Kentucky Buttermilk Biscuits
description: a beautiful recipe for a high, fluffy kfc type of biscuit.  i originally did this with self rising flour, but have adjusted it to be easier and faster with bisquick--the same great taste and flavor is still there or i would not be posting it.

name: Crock Pot Venison Roast
description: i used to always cut our venison roasts up into cubes and make venison stew until my sister shared this recipe with me!  we now have roast once a week.  i don't think that you can overcook this.  i make french dips with the leftovers...if there are any!  *october 2009--i've recently made a couple of changes to this recipe that i think have made it even better...i started using black coffee instead of water to make a darker, richer gravy.  i also now use low sodium montreal steak seasoning.

name: Crock Pot Vegetarian Lasagna
description: this is an easy lasagna to make.  it smells wonderful while cooking and tastes great.  i adapted this recipe from a combination of others and came up with this vegetarian version.  you can make this vegan easily by adding more of your favorite vegetables and using soy cheeses.  even the non vegetarians i made this for had seconds.

name: Crock Pot Turkey Breast
description: super simple and super tasty.

name: Easy  Creamy Hamburger Stroganoff
description: this easy version of stroganoff is so delicious. i have people beg me to make it for them when they come over for dinner. hope you enjoy it!

name: Beef Brisket Crock Pot
description: a great brisket for hot weather, no need to heat up your kitchen.

name: Edamame And Corn Salad
description: oxmoor house, april 2009

name: Edamame And Corn Salsa
description: found this recipe in a runners world magazine.  tastes great and is a good source of protein and fiber.  i usually serve the salsa with pita chips

name: Crock Pot Tijuana Turkey
description: the cocoa in this dish imparts a richness and mysterious nuance.  peanut butter replaces the usual ground nuts.

name: Crock Pot Texas Chili
description: this is so good on a cold winter day and it's also easy to prepare.

name: Crock Pot Swiss Steak
description: an excellent 'away all day' meal to come home to...

name: Crock Pot Winter Dinner
description: a simple dinner made in the crock pot for those cold winter nights.  this recipe combines chicken tenderloins with polish sausage, pork and beans, great northern beans and butter beans all cooked in a sweetened tomatoey sauce.

name: Easy  Oven Baked Cod
description: taken from rachael ray's 30-minute meals, this is amazingly quick, fresh, and light - can be made with any type of fish fillet. of course, my usual salad-in-a-bag is a lifesaver here, and fresh broccoli steamed in the microwave or asparagus roasted alongside the fish completes the meal!

name: Crock Pot Stewed Apples
description: this is such a comfort food to me in the fall and winter. i hope you like it as much as i do!

name: Easy Twice Baked Potatoes
description: these are easy to cook and assemble and can be frozen to be used as needed.  i use large potatoes, so 1/2 stuffed potato shell is one serving.

name: Easy Tofu For Everyone
description: this tofu recipe is idiot-proof and delicious.  your friends who swear they do not eat tofu will be begging you for more. they key to tofu is draining it well, so i've provided instructions for that. i use this tofu for everything; to top salads, thrown in stir-fry, in sandwiches, even in soups. it should be the consistency of well-cooked scrambled-eggs when done. the prep-time does not include draining time.

name: Easy Tomato Bean Soup
description: i got this recipe out of cooking light. the aromatic combination of pinto beans and tomatoes is perfect for a cold weather supper and is simple to prepare. great with a turkey sandwich

name: Easy Tomato Mozzarella Bruschetta
description: this is a simple bruchetta recipe sure to impress guests!

name: Easy Tuna Salad Sandwiches
description: i was in a rush to make a quick snack. this did the trick. can also be used to put on top of lettuce for a salad instead.

name: Easy Turkey Pot Pie
description: this is an easy pot pie recipe that is great for using leftover turkey or chicken.  you can add any vegetables that you like.

name: Easy Turkey Roll Ups
description: very adaptable to your own taste, try adding chopped olives, altering the herbs to your own taste and adding crispy bacon or spinach leaves.  lite sour cream is an alternative to mayonnaise. make sure to roll them quite tightly.  flattening with a rolling pin first is a help and refrigerate till needed.

name: Easy Vegan Apple Crisp
description: for nutrition info.

name: Easy Warm Lentil Salad
description: this recipe was featured in this months family circle. i have eliminated the sausage called for in the original recipe to make this a great, easy vegan option!

name: Easy Vegan Chocolate Cake
description: super yummy and super quick, this chocolate cake is accidentally vegan!  it can be made from scraps found around most kitchens.  to make cupcakes instead, just fill a cupcake pan (greased and floured or with cups) 3/4 full and bake for 20 minutes instead.

name: Easy Vegan Overnight Oats
description: this is from ohsheglows.com and it is so easy, and so healthy, and so tasty, you're going to make it every day! you can eat it as is, or add in a tsp of sugar or maple syrup if you want it sweetker. (it really depends what kind of milk you use.  vanilla almond milk wouldn't need the sugar or vanilla for example.) i usually add a little ground flax too to put this in the over-the-top good for you category.

name: Crock Pot Chai Tea
description: a chai tea recipe that is made in the crockpot. found online at familycrockpotrecipes.com and storing it here for safe-keeping. i have not tried this yet,

name: Easy Vegetarian Collard Greens
description:
this is a wonderful way to make delicious, tender, vegan collard greens. the smoked sweet paprika in these greens imparts a wonderful smoky flavor without the traditional but decidedly non-kosher and non-vegetarian smoked ham hock. make sure the paprika you buy is smoked, as the regular kind won't give you that smoky flavor.

whatever you do, don't discard the pot liquor! it is full of the nutrients and flavor that have leached out of the greens during cooking, and makes a very full-bodied and rich broth you can use as a replacement for water when making rice (my favorite), as the base for soups or stews, or in any other savory dish that requires broth or water.

name: Easy Veggie Lo Mein
description: this easy homemade version of a classic chinese takeout dish tastes much better than the takeout version, and it's healthier too.  you may choose to adjust the spice level by using more or less crushed red pepper flakes or none at all.  also, other vegetables may be substituted per your preference.  i hope others enjoy this recipe as much as my family does!  (please note this recipe is not authentic chinese and never claimed to be.)

name: Easy Velveeta Salsa Dip
description: serve this dip with tortilla chips or tacos, it's just creamy delicious! this dip is served warm. don't omit the beer!

name: Crock Pot Stuffed Cabbage
description: this sounds like a great way to make stuffed cabbage in the crock pot. i wanted to post this recipe so that i would have it available when i get around to making it.

name: Crock Pot Spinach Special
description: this is a yummy way to eat spinach - even my kids will eat it. it is adapted from the "fix it & forget it" cookbook.

name: Crock Pot Mac   Cheese
description: i have given this recipe to many people who have said it has become a "must have" at all their family gatherings.

name: Crock Pot Mushroom Stroganoff
description: i have been making this for years. co workers have literally begged me to make this for them instead of sweets. i usually use a mixture of button and baby portabellos, but the exotic mix is good to throw in as well. make it fancy for a pot luck....toss it with the noodles in a casserole and top with garlic buttered breadcrumbs and bake until they are golden. looks like you fussed for hours! you could substitute vegetable broth to make it vegetarian.

name: Egg Free Oatmeal Cookies
description: a sweet treat for those that can't tolerate eggs. from our local newspaper.

name: Egg Heaven Cheese Lovers
description: i love this quick eight minute breakfast. when i send the hubbie off to work and  the boys off to school, i break out this dish. it keeps my tummy full all day. just watch it; it's so easy and good you just might get addicted.

name: Crock Pot Pork Tacos
description: a wonderful filling for tacos, burritos or on chips!! an easy way to wow people with no effort. great for mexican food buffet.

name: Crock Pot Pork Sandwiches
description: this is a little different than the usual barbecue sauce. it has a nice cajun flavor. the tomatoes make an excellent sauce for the tender shredded pork. this recipe is from easy meals by betty crocker.

name: Crock Pot Pizza Beans
description: simple and hearty, this recipe can be easily adapted to suit your families personal taste. i use whatever canned beans are in my pantry. this is always a hit with my family and my schedule.

name: Berry Patch Brownie Pizza
description: a recipe from taste of home i want to try soon. you can't go wrong with brownies.

name: Egg Salad For One
description: super simple . . . and good.

name: Crock Pot Pulled Chicken
description: a healthier alternative to pulled pork! easy to make in the crock pot.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich Spread
description: easy basic recipe, but i love it!

name: Egg Substitute For Baking
description: this is a great substitute for anyone who either has an egg allergy or... if you're like me and you have a recipe that needs eggs fast and youre completely out. it's great, and it's fast!

name: Crock Pot Mexican Beef
description: this is a great crock pot meal for those busy nights. we like to serve it over rice.

name: Crock Pot Meatball Stroganoff
description: you will not believe how easy this is! i found this recipe in taste of home's "simple and delicious" magazine.

name: Bert S Special Meatloaf
description: this is my kids' favourite meal. and the leftovers make a great sandwich the next day!

name: Egg Free French Toast
description: i found this recipe on mrbreakfast.com. having a very allergic child, i was thrilled to find this recipe. egg-free french toast? who knew?!

name: Egg Drop Chicken Soup
description: i have not made this, just posting.  a very easy soup and low in calories.  pol martin cookbook

name: Crock Pot Pulled Pork
description: last year i received a crock pot cookbook with a recipe in it for pulled pork. it was nice but i thought the sauce it made in the pot was a bit too thin. i made several changes and am happy with this recipe so its time to share it! i sometimes have to water the sauce down now. the sauce/marinade can be made up to 3 days in advance and kept in the fridge until needed. marinating time is not included. i make this in my 3 1/2 quart crock pot.

name: Edgar Allen Poe Pizza
description: there is a pizza chain called dewey's that makes this. of course, i don't have their fabulous crust recipe here (if i did i'd be out selling pizza). just use the best, lightest, average thickness crust you have (preferably home made). if it turns out even halfway like the pizza at dewey's, i promise your desire to eat other pizza will be "nevermore". and yeah, i am still working on bringing you that crust recipe!

name: Berry Mandarin Tossed Salad
description: this was a recipe found in quick cooking magazine posted by linda jo wahlgren. this is a great picnic take-along.

name: Crock Pot Southwestern Chops
description: very easy slow cook supper. we add a salad to this.

name: Crock Pot Shredded Beef
description: this is an easy, flavorable way to cook a chuck roast that offers lots of options.

name: Berry Mallow Yam Bake
description: i've made this casserole almost every year for about 20 years at thanksgiving. it's become a tradition and the whole family loves it, i hope you will like it, too!

name: Edith S Pea Salad
description: edith was a lady i used to work with. she brought this salad to a luncheon, and i thought it was very good.

name: Crock Pot Sherry Chicken
description: i don't remeber where i got this recipe but everyone in my family loves it ! it extremely easy and now that my sons are grown and bringing home potential daughter in laws i love to tease them about my "secret" chicken recipe they can't have unless they become family. oh, and the lemon at the beginning is optional . i incuded it to be true to the recipe but often don't use it.

name: Crock Pot Rotisserie Chicken
description:
very tasty and easy!
because of the foil balls, the fat drains off the chicken as it cooks.

name: Egg   Sausage Breakfast Burrito
description: this is so easy and delicious whether frozen or eaten fresh and it's very easy to add variety each time.

name: Crock Pot Roast  Oamc
description: got this recipe/tip from a friend, great for the winter time, and it leaves your crock pot clean!  please note that my crockpot is a heavy ceramic one from the 80's.  in view of a reviewers comment - i can only ask that you please cook for the full length of time stated in the recipe for your first time, keeping an eye on it of course, and then adjust from there.

name: Crock Pot Roasted Garlic
description: this is a great method for roasting garlic, so it can be ready when you start cooking in the evening. i've even done it overnight and started cooking in the morning. roasted garlic goes great with mashed potatoes, on pasta, or simply spread on crusty bread.

name: Egg And Apple Bruschetta
description: from better homes and gardens' fresh and simple vegetarian dinners, this recipe has been slightly tweaked!

name: Berry Melon Agua Fresca
description: from sunset via the cooking light website.

name: Egg And Bacon Quesadilla
description: this is a great recipe for an easy breakfast or dinner. my kids especially like it.

name: Egg And Ham Pinwheels
description: these are my husbands favourite pinwheels.  they are based on his love of ham & egg sandwiches :) these can also be eaten as a wrap for lunch. i haven't included chilling time in prep or cooking time.

name: Egg And Vegemite Soldiers
description: i grew up with vegemite soldiers, my grandmother made them for my mum, my mum used to make them for me, and then i made them for my kids, and i guess it's just one of those things that will continue. i still love this recipe every now and then and so do my teenage kids and dh. yes we are all happy little vegemites here!!!! and of course it goes without saying the spread must be vegemite........no alternatives !!!!

name: Easy German Chocolate Cake
description: this cake is surprisingly moist without being too rich or heavy and it is very easy to make. enjoy!

name: Easy Garlic Cheese Biscuits
description: cheddar-flavored biscuits quick using biscuit mix.

name: Beef Shepherd S Pie
description: from food network. from now on, my only shepherd's pie recipe.

name: Earl Grey Salad Dressing
description: adapted from southern living. this uses tea to flavor the dressing.

name: Delta Zeta Party Snacks
description: i made this snack mix for a parent's weekend get-together for my daughter's sorority and it was a hit.  it's easy to make and you can substitute any of the snacks.  i lined my pan with parchment paper and was glad i did!  i put individual servings in fall goodie bags so that it was easy for guests to take their own bag.  the recipe comes from a junior league cookbook.

name: Dyck Family Pizza Dough
description: we've used this recipe for years so we've had lots of time to tweak it. the whole wheat adds extra flavour, texture, and its heart smart.

name: Beer Soaked Flank Steak
description: i don't remember where i got this recipe, but it's one that we have enjoyed a lot. the times do not include marinating time.

name: Delicious White Chicken Chili
description: this white chili recipe was given to me by a neighbor and is the best one i have found.  when making it, i use lowfat sour cream, lowfat or fat free half & half.

name: Delicious Vegetable Beef Soup
description: this is a really good soup! it's not hard to make. i'm only 14 and i made it. my family loved it and keep begging me to make it again!

name: E Z Seasoning Salt
description: use spices right out of your cupboard and never buy a premix again! make this mix yours by adding an extra amount of your favorite spice!

name: Delicious Steamed Whole Artichokes
description: from food 911, these are so good! i used to live in watsonville, california, the artichoke capital!

name: Beefsteak And Mushroom Pie
description: couldn't find one just like this on zaar- delicious and comforting.

name: Earl S Mediterranean Linguini
description: earl's is a chain that was started in north vancouver, british columbia.  i served for them for a few years and love their food.  this was one of my favourites and they've taken it off the menu.  thank goodness i was able to find a good copycat recipe on the net.  it's so good you can even eat it cold!!  i think i'll add marinated artichokes next time as a twist.  add some grilled chicken breast or shrimp if you want protein.

name: Easier Stabilized Whipped Cream
description: this is much easier than the usual unflavored gelatin method. as for the leftover pudding mix, i use it in smoothies, milk shakes, fruit salads, more whipped cream, etc. it never goes to waste!you can make your whipped topping ahead of time and it won't separate or go runny!  i find the pudding adds an extra richness to the flavor without being enough to know that it's instant pudding. you could use any flavor of instant pudding to change up the usual whipped cream flavors.

name: Easiest And Best Fudge
description: one of the best things i loved about my job was the sharing of delicious treats at our potlucks - one christmas potluck this fudge was arrived and i was lucky enough to grab some before it was all gone...i threw out all of my other fudge recipes because this one couldn't be simpler and tastes the best of all.  my husband doesn't like nuts in his fudge so i leave it out and it's still delicious.

name: Delicious Pork And Noodles
description:
this is the simplest pork and noodles recipe i know.  it takes only 5 ingredients - two of which are salt and pepper. my kids love this!! you'll be amazed at how good this is.  

i cook the meat in my crockpot, but my mom has always done it on the stovetop.  i never believed her when she said it was flavored basically with salt, pepper and beef broth.  i thought i was so smart and added spices and garlic, but i found that nothing i tried was as good as her version.  as they say, mother knows best....uuggghhh!

name: Easiest Chicken Pot Pie
description: great on a cold night when you want comfort food!

name: Easiest Ever Corn Casserole
description: this recipe is super easy to throw together for a holiday party or as a side dish.  it comes out perfectly delicious every time and is great with meatloaf, turkey, or chicken.

name: Dutch East Indies Meatballs
description: these can be served as appetizers, or over rice as a main dish.  the surprise is the chunk of pineapple in the middle of the meatball!  this makes 4 servings as a main dish, or 8 appetizer servings.

name: Dustin S Chicken Spiedini
description: this recipe was submitted to paula deen by a fan who was wondering why in the world she never cooked italian food.  she decided to try her hand at it and the result?  real tasty italian cuising with a down-home southern feel.  mangia-mangia!

name: Delicious Orange Chocolate Muffins
description:
this is an adaption of a friend's. my nephew devoured them as they came out of the oven!
the frozen butter fully dissolves as it cooks and creates mini pockets of air which provide a light texture.
they last well for a couple of days in an air tight container.

name: Dry Rub For Pork
description: my rub is not quite the same as the others here.  notably, i don't put any mustard in mine, due to my wife's allergy.

description: fruit roll-ups

name: Dried Fruit Salad 2
description: from the "sunday express", a recipe by anthony worrall thompson for a baked fruit breakfast.

name: Drop Baking Powder Biscuits
description: from the new settlement cookbook. these are so easy and yummy. don't overwork the dough or the biscuits get tough. also make sure they are thick enough. that's what makes them fluffy and soft.

name: Deviled Eggs With Curry
description: this was the hit of my last party! people couldn't get enough of these pop-in-your-mouth bits of heaven and everyone asked what was in them. funny thing was, they were the easiest app to make.

name: Dropped Date Filled Cookies
description:
do you just love filled cookies but hate the fussiness of making them?  these are dropped and you don't have to roll them out.  the filling is even dropped on top of the drop.
easy and good.

description: a recipe i learned from a thai cooking course in thailand

name: Dry Rub Pork Ribs
description: a simple, no hassle, no mess and delicious method for

name: Dena S Kale Salad
description: my friend dena brought this over for a dinner party, and it was excellent. she said it's her copycat version of new frontier's overpriced kale salad.

name: Deviled Beef Hamburger Patties
description: my all-time favorite hamburger patty for making american style burgers. i found the original recipe in the better homes and gardens barbecue book back in the 70's and this is the only recipe i ever use.  it has been modified somewhat, but it retains most of the original ingredients. i always have a bottle of chili sauce in the refrigerator at all times for making these.  although you can perhaps substitute ketchup for chili sauce the taste will not be the same. you need to mix this meat mixture thoroughly.  i use circular motion to get fat from ground beef and egg emulsified. the original recipe is for 4 hamburger patties but i usually make 5 patties because i like my patties smaller than quarter pounder.

name: Dulce De Leche Icing
description: i had some leftover dulce de leche from another recipe and i made up this icing with the rest.  it is really good!! you can find nestle dulce de leche in the latin or mexican section of your grocery store.  i hope you like it!

name: Dump Maple Mustard Chicken
description: this is my all time favorite from ellie kreiger on food network.

name: Beer Marinade For Fajitas
description: here in the land of microbrews (the beautiful pacific nw), this marinade goes over really well.  :)  it is a really versatile recipe, and you can easily add or subtract amounts of the ingredients to suit your tastes - experiment and enjoy!

name: Denita S Potato Salad
description: this is my mother's potato salad, and it is so tasty! the secret ingredient (cheeze whiz) is what really makes this salad different!

name: Durkee Famous Sauce Clone
description: this wonderful tasting, versatile sauce has been a secret ingredient in many southern recipes for as long as i can remember. it was originally patented in 1857. it is used in potato salad, cole slaw dressing, remoulade sauce, egg salads and various other salad/dressing recipes. we love it spread on bread for turkey sandwiches. while the

name: Easiest Ever Fettuccine Alfredo
description: no separate cooking for the sauce in this awesome dish. ready for the table in minutes.

name: Easiest Fruit Dip Ever
description: my family love this dip.  always a favourite at family get-togethers and pot luck.  serve with any kind of fresh fruit.

name: Dressed Up Fried Potatoes
description: i got this recipe from my friendly bartender at the pub i frequented in seoul. his were latka style potatoes, but mine didn't turn out that way. lol regardless, i found a great way to make some very tasty fried potatoes. cooking time does not include cooling potatoes in the fridge.

name: Easy  And Tasty  Meatloaf
description: this is the meatloaf recipe my family has used my whole life. i love it! of course, we have to double to whole recipe, using 2 to 3 pounds ground beef, the whole package of onion soup mix, and a 12 fluid ounce can of carnation evaporated milk. this is good with baked potatoes and some bush's baked beans. (or any other vegetables: corn, peas...) i hope you like it!

name: Easy   Quick Amish Bread
description:
i have had this recipe for at least 10 years, it was given to my by my mom after i got married but i just started making this about a year ago when i got pregnant with my second child and only wanted fresh homemade baked bread.. this bread is awesome. i make at least 4 loaves a week for my family. it is the simplest bread recipe i have and the tastiest . 1 loaf is usually gone hours after it comes out of the oven.

now here is the thing i am not avid baker, if its too complicated i screw it up, so this recipe in my book is fool proof..... if you make it and it doesn't come out.. you did something out of order ,... it is not the recipe.... follow the mixing directions exactly.. good baking and enjoy..

name: Easy   Quick Broccoli Bake

name: Eastern Nc Collard Greens
description:
once the first frost kisses the collards, they are ready for picking. we get entire plants, cut at the base like cabbages from certain roadside stands & use 'em all! big flat heavy leaves are every bit as good as tender inner leaves if done right.  some folks cut out the center ribs on the bigger leaves  - we prefer to string out the strings & snap the stems up. we were also taught not to cut a collard, they are to be torn after soaking in 3 sinkfuls of water to remove any grit. start the braising pot a the evening before cooking collards, to give the ham hocks time to cook down.
don't be daunted by the amount - collards do cook down a lot! remember to serve with cornbread to sop up the pot liquor - this can be a full meal for collard lovers. dig in!

for the pork averse, 5 or 6 smoked turkey wings may be substituted but they lack tha "jes right" flavor of ham hock. interestingly, ham hock is very low in fat & provides more flavor in the form of gelatin (like oxtail) - apparent only after chilling the pot liquor!

name: Easter Hard Boiled Eggs
description:
a gruszecki tradition and now ours, is that each person gets a colored egg at the beginning of the meal, right after "grace". each person uses his/her egg to tap on everyone else at the table, while wishing them a happy easter. part of the trick is to be the last one with an egg not crushed. after you smack eggs with everyone at the table, the egg gets peeled and eaten.

the following are a few hints that will help you cook the best hardboiled eggs:

the fresher the egg, the harder it will be to peal it. you should purchase your eggs 2 weeks before you'll be cooking them in order to get them to peal easy.

and, the way to get the yolk to be in the center of the egg after it's boiled, is to store them on their side. this relieves the pressure on the membrane within the egg that holds it suspended.

the green coloring on the outside of the yolk is caused by cooking them too long. cooking by the directions below will eliminate that.

for additional pictures, please visit:
