description: this is in response to a recipe request...haven't tried it yet, but i definitely will soon.

name: Dark   Creamy Chocolate Cake
description: taken from the magazine section of the 2/7/10 sunday newspaper.  i haven't made this yet, but it sounds yummy!

name: Danish French Bread  Franskbrod
description: this is my own creation of a danish french bread called franskbrod. i missed it so much here in canada, that i got down to business and experimented enough to have it down right... enjoy with homemade peach jam, or some danish havarti. velbekomme!

name: Easy Chicken Noodle Casserole
description: easy to throw together, and easy to lower the fat content.  substitute low fat cream of mushroom soup and use skim milk.  voila, lower fat :)

name: Easy Cool Cucumber Salad
description: i adapted this from a recipe from the june 2011 issue of the food network magazine; as i only had about half the ingredients i had to improvise. glad i did, it's a tasty and cooling side dish i'll enjoy during our cabo hot season. hope someone out there enjoys it.

name: Dan S Chicken Enchiladas
description: this is my father's receipt. we like to top each with some sour cream, salsa, shredded lettuce and diced tomato. very good ;) and can be made with any meat you prefer.

name: Delicious Asian Broccoli Slaw
description: easy and delicious  salad - always a hit!

name: Easy Egyptian Feta Salad
description: here is a super simple salad that will be a great accompaniment to any north african main dish. you can enjoy it on its own too.

name: Easy Diet Turkey Soup
description: yummy, fast and diet friendly soup

name: Dad S Herbed Chicken
description: i got this recipe from my dad 20 years ago, via my brother after a visit to california.  my dad is gone now and this recipe makes me think of him and miss him, but it also makes me happy to be able to share it with my family.  slow-roasted, it’s fall-off-the-bone good, and the skin so yummy and crispy!  my kids and i fight over it!

name: Dad S Fettuccine Alfredo
description: my dad learned to make this when he worked at a very fancy italian restaurant.  it's his signature dish, so i was shocked to learn that it only has 3 ingredients.

name: Dad S Clam Dip
description: this was my father's specialty while i was growing up. he made it for holidays and company. slightly different from the other clam dips i've seen on zaar.

name: Dad S Cheese Ball
description: great twist on an old time party treat!

name: Easy Eggplant  Aubergine  Parmigiana
description: use your favourite marinara sauce! this is so easy and good you'll wonder why you avoided trying it. from "the sopranos" the one hour of prep time includes 30 minutes of draining.

name: Dad S Carrot Cake
description: this is my dad's recipe for his well-known carrot cake... it stays moist forever... well as long as it's not eaten... ;)

name: Beef Stew For 100
description: need a warm, down home style meal for a crowd, then try this one.

name: Dad S Apple Crisp
description: my dad has been making this for me ever since i was a little kid.  this recipe is nice because there is not a lot leftover to tempt you for breakfast :)

name: D Best Dinner Rolls
description: i went out on a limb to try out this new recipe idea on my family for thanksgiving, and it was a huge hit!  the chicken stock makes all the difference.

name: Easy Fiesta Christmas Tree
description: this is a cute little appetizer for the holidays! you probably have most, if not all, of the ingredients in your pantry. it's great for any type of get-togethers, picnics, tail-gaters, or pot lucks.i make several of these and set them around the areas where most of the people are.be sure to serve napkins!!!

name: Easy Flounder Au Gratin
description: don't know where i got this recipe.  found it in my fish recipes on a handwritten card.  i haven't tried this yet.

name: Easy French Dip Sandwiches
description: this is my version of crock-pot french dip sandwiches. my daughter hates beer in recipes so this one's for her.

name: Easy Frozen Fruit Smoothie
description:
quick, easy and very refreshing on these hot summer days.  we use it as an added fruit for the day before dinner usually, but it works well anytime of the day.  
even though the lemonade we use is sugar-free, the drink doesn't taste like artificial sweetener. 
all the measurements are approximate.

name: Dad S Pride Fruitcake
description: dad's pride fruitcake

name: Dad S Roast Chicken
description: the perfect roast chicken for all occasions.

name: Easy Cranberry   Apple Cake
description: this recipe is inspired by a cranberry pie from sarah chase’s book cold weather cooking. i haven't made it yet, but i will soon - sounds scrumptious!

name: Easy Crock Pot Chicken
description:
4 ingredients, a couple spices, and *poof*...8 hours in a crock pot and dinner is ready!  we served ours over rice...delicious!  
you can probably use whatever kind of 'cream of --- soup' you have, these are just the ones that i used.

name: Dan S Baja Chicken
description: in my many years in the kitchen, i stumbled upon this recipe in my experimentations with cooking for clients who wanted something "different." the most important part of this recipe is the marinade. once marinated, the chicken can be broiled, grilled, fried, or cooked any other way, depending on your dietary wishes/requirements. best served with "party rice" (which i will post a recipe for later ;-)), this dish also goes well with baked potatoes or penne tossed in garlic and olive oil.

name: Dampfnudela Steamed German Dumplings
description: my grandmother use to make these when i was a kid and we would eat them as bread right out of the frying pan.  these have a crisp salty tasting bottom and soft top.  so many memories this recipe brings back!!serve with canned pears.. this is good with very crisp cooked bacon with the sauerkraut and of course sauted onions.

name: Easy Cream Drop Biscuits
description: a friend gave me this recipe; with only 4 ingredients, it's super easy.  tasty, too!

name: Easy Creamy Clam Chowder
description: you may omit the garlic if desired, i like to add it in.

name: Easy Crispy Cornflake Potatoes
description: one of our favorite ways to make potatoes and you generally have the ingredients on hand. it's out of a church cookbook by suzanne sachs

name: Dairy Free Pumpkin Pie
description:
my great grandmother from england always made the best pumpkin pie, and the recipe has been passed along in the family for generations.  when i became lactose intolerant, i was depressed by the notion that i would no longer be able to enjoy the pie at thanksgiving because the original recipe was loaded with dairy.  

after a lot of experimentation and testing, i successfully converted the family recipe to a dairy free version i can enjoy, while maintaining the flavor and consistency of the pie that has made it such a hit.  family members who have tasted this new version were unable to tell a difference.

name: Easy Crock Pot Barbecue
description: this is sooo good and sooo easy. put it in the crockpot before work and when you come home dinner is almost ready. the vinegar may be off-putting at first but it makes the meat so tender it just falls apart. and you won't be able to taste it!

name: Dad S Singing Hinnie
description: the singing hinnie was so called because, as it cooks, it makes a sizzling noise. an old tale is told of how this large tea-time scone first became known as a singing hinnie.  a north country housewife was baking this scone for tea and on repeatedly being asked by her children if it was ready to eat, her final reply was "no, it's just singing, hinnies". (hinnies is a geordie (northeast england) term of endearment for children and loved ones.)

name: Dairy Free Berry Trifle
description: its always an issue when we entertain to make sure that the dessert meets the needs of the guests and that my dairy allergic child does not feel he is missing out.  this recipe meets all needs.  delicious and looks great.  i get frustrated when i'm left with egg whites or egg yolks, so i decided to add meringue to this recipe.  nice and crunchy.

name: Bell Pepper Bonanza Marzetti
description: mellow, colby cheese, no mushrooms, just the way my mil loves it.  i make this casserole ahead for a change of pace for my mil. this grew out of johnny marzetti in jean anderson's american century cookbook.

name: Daily Energy Protein Smoothie
description: i obtained this recipe from my naturopathic doctor. i adjusted her recipe to my own tastes and arrived at this tasty, filling and healthy smoothie.

name: Easy Cuban Black Beans
description: you would never guess that this recipe uses canned beans.  don't skip the chorizo as it adds a lovely bottom note to the flavour of the dish.  muy facil!

name: Dads Ultimate Protein Bar
description: our weight lifting boys were eating me out of house and home with energy and protein bars! so after trying 10 - 15 different recipes i combined what i liked and left out what i didnt...with a few twists.  the recipe is very simple and versatile.  listed you will see honey but using maple syrup is just as good.  use what ever nut and dried fruit you like.  i also mix up chocolate versus vanilla soy protein.  hope you enjoy as much as we do.

name: Daddy S Triple Chicken
description:
my husband decided to make dinner for me and oh was it great!!! a must try!!! delish!!! will be in your favorites!!!
my kids loved it too!!! my 5 year old girl, my 3 year old girl and my 2 year old son!

name: Easy Cheesy Pork Chops
description: one pan! quick prep! don't remember where it came from but it really is great!

name: Easy Cheesy Pork Casserole
description: here is a great recipe i got from another website, but i'm not sure which one. this is easy to put together and the pork turns out tender and juicy.

name: Easy Cheesy Pasta Pot
description: i couldn't think of anything i wanted on a cold winter day. i was all by myself so this comfort food was made for only 1 person. feel free to pick the frozen veggies that you like. i like crunch so added some french's fried onions. it definately hit the spot (a very generous serving). i think i will try an expanded version for the family soon.

name: Easy Blackberry Jam Pudding
description: this is another neat recipe i found online.i really enjoy recipes like this. they are very warm,cozy but easy to make.have not made this yet,but i am sure i will soon!8)

name: Easy Batter Fruit Cobbler
description: this is an easy to make cobbler that can be made with whatever fresh fruit is in season-sliced peaches or nectarines, or whole  strawberries,raspberries, blackberries, or a combination of berries. a 12 ounce bag of frozen mixed berries may also be used, but in my opinion, fresh is better! serve warm or at room temperaure with a dollop of whipped cream or a scoop of vanilla ice cream. originally from a sunday usa weekend magazine.

name: Easy Bbq Chicken Marinade
description: came up with this one on the fly. this quantity of ingredients will be sufficient marinade for 4 drumsticks. i like to use zipper-seal bags for marinating because the air can be removed so that the meat is surrounded by marinade, which means i can throw it into the fridge and forget about it until cooking time. i get a nice, even marinade on every piece without any extra fuss. plus, it is one less dish to wash after.

name: Easy Beef And Potatoes
description: i made this yesterday for the first time and i will be making again. i replaced the tomato soup with a can of hunts tomato sauce and i sprinkle in some basil.

name: Easy Bisquick  Zucchini Squares
description: this is an easy simple recipe just mix and bake and these freeze excellent!

name: Easy Bisquick Coffee Cake
description: very easy and perfect warm with a little pat of butter! :)

name: Beef Stroganoff Stuffed Potatoes
description: i found this recipe in some magazine a few months back.  dad and i have fell in love with it.  when i cook something new my dad tells me this recipe is a keeper or toss it.  this was a keeper and i was very happy because it is so simple to make.

name: Beef Stroganoff  Stonyfield Yogurt
description:
from stonyfield farm website

this hearty dish has been made healthier by using yogurt in place of sour cream in the finished sauce. if you would like to omit the wine, use 1 cup of beef broth instead. serve this convenient dish over rice or egg noodles and enjoy! 

nutrition facts 
calories 340; calories from fat 150; total fat 17g; cholesterol 70mg; total carbohydrates 13g; protein 29g, fiber 2g

name: Easy Banana Pudding Cheesecake
description: found this online and everyone went crazy over it even if they didn't like bananas!

name: Beet Pickled Deviled Eggs
description: this is from epicurious. i'm putting it here for safe-keeping.

name: Dee S Salisbury Steak
description: i made this when i was looking for a way to cook hamburger.  remember to check cooking times as all ovens are different--mine is old and slow--lol.  i'm hoping all my measurements are right as i'm doing this from memory and math is not my strong suit.

name: Dee S Margarita  Pie
description: i made this up after looking at recipes at zaar and.  i didn't have some of the stuff, of course, half way through the recipe--lol.

name: Dee S Baked Vegetables
description: a coworker served this at a party and everyone loved them. everyone asked for the recipe. a great way to add vegetables to your diet.

name: Decorated Football Poke Cupcakes
description: another cool football tailgate recipe. i, of course, choose green and gold as the only good colors to use for this recipe. you may use any other colors you wish. go pack go!!!

name: Deconstructed Jalapeno Poppers Balls
description:
my favorite part of a jalapeno popper was always the cream crease and the fried breading.  this recipe is super easy and lets the cream cheese play a bigger role.  **please note the preparation time is mostly chilling time.


confession, i am a huge wimp when it comes to hot food and as this recipe is written, it's a little more spicy than i'd prefer.  but with fewer peppers you lose a lot of the flavor.


if you love heat, you can add more jalapenos or use fresh instead of jarred which are usually much hotter.


i serve with a mild salsa and ranch dip, both go well with flavors and texture.

name: Deep Dish  Lisa  Pizza
description: pizza's are so much fun to make - especially when they turn out to be so yummy!! :) i encourage you to take liberties with this recipe. this is a good base and taste's great as-is. but, i'm sure you could improve it with your own ideas! :)

name: Beet  Barley   Walnut Salad
description: i love grain salads and find those made with barley tend to keep very well.  if you make this ahead, you'll just need to store the beets separately.  i think this makes enough for about 8 as a side.  this came from alive magazine.  i like to add some fresh herbs into the dressing, whatever i have on hand.  other types of vinegar would work well here.

name: Easy Cheesy Party Dip
description: this is so simple but its always a favorite at parties. variations are almost endless with the choices of salsas available these days. you get to choose hot or mild, chunky or saucy. personally i love the chunky chipotle kind.

name: Dehydrator Granny Smith Granola
description: this recipe is from the nesco dehydrator website.

name: Delicious Apple Pie Cake
description: this is a fantastic recipe, and a great way to use up the apples that you may have on hand, or in this case, the can of apple pie filling. either way, it's tasty. turbinado sugar is sometimes used in place of brown sugar. it's also called "sugar in the raw" and can be found next to the granulated sugar. i think that this is much better served warm, and served with a piece of cheddar cheese. or, some vanilla yougurt would be nice. rather than heating the whole cake up, try heating individual pieces in the microwave.

name: Easy Bake Oven Quesadilla
description: recipes for use in the easy bake oven.

name: Easy Baked Chicken Parmigiana
description: baked breaded chicken smothered w/ marinara sauce and mozzarella baked over spiral noodles.  you can also make this low fat.

name: Easy Baked Garlic Soup
description: you will have to taste it to believe it. soooo gooood.

name: Beet Salad  Georgian Style
description: this unusual combo of beets, walnuts and prunes makes a gorgeous and easy salad which keeps well in the fridge for quite a while. serve it w/ any meat or poultry dish, or in a buffet w/ other dips and salads. the color is vivid magenta!

name: Delectable Baked Orange Roughy
description: i love buttery, lemony white fish so i devised this simple recipe. for this dish, you can use roughy, tilapia, whitefish, halibut.... any nice white fish fillet. and this is a great way for newbies to seafood to break in. the technique is pretty forgiving of mistakes and the fish will be done, but not overcooked. enjoy!

name: Easy Baked Potato Wedges
description: we love these potatoes, they are simple to make and taste great!

name: Easy Banana French Toast
description: this is a simple and quick way to use those still good but aesthetically non-pleasing week-old bananas.  i like to use a less dense, lighter bread with this recipe, like normal sandwich bread.

name: Deep Fried Sea Bass
description: i like this recipe because its quick and simple. i found it on a web search at "the recipe box" web site. my preferrence is spicier so i added several ingredients.

name: Easy Baking Powder Babka
description: posted by request. i have always made a yeast version, which can be very time consuming. i think i will give this one a try. for lucre see recipe #23181.

name: Deep Fried Jalapeno Slices
description: these are really good. the heat depends on the pepper, i have had them very mild and taste bud burnin hot. they are best eaten fresh but are good reheated.

name: Deep Flavor Pizza Sauce
description: i have cobbled together quite a few recipes and ingredients trying to find a sauce that is rich in flavor without being too sweet.  it's still a work in progress - but i don't want to loose the ingredients the next time i make it.

name: Deep Dish Pizza Dough
description: the best pizza dough ever!!! this recipe orginated from the

name: Easy Banana Cream Pie
description: easy and yummy pie that goes together quickly. you can use a chocolate crumb crust rather than a shortbread if you like. both are tasty. cooking time is actually chilling time.

name: Easy Braised Pork Chops
description: this recipe creates very juicy tender pork chops, and caramelized onions. i serve the onions over mashed potatoes.

name: Easy Brazilian Cheese Puffs
description: there are a number of other brazilian cheese puff recipes out there but most of them use a starch and parmesan cheese.  this is a great variation that is a bit easier to make than the traditional puffs.

name: Easy Breakfast Nacho Bake
description: who says you only have to have nachos for appetizers? this is a quick breakfast or brunch dish that has lots of zip.

name: Day After Thanksgiving  Dinner
description: several years ago, on the friday after thanksgiving, i wanted to use my leftovers for something other than a turkey sandwich or turkey soup.  i opened up all the containers in the fridge and came up with this.  it's a family favorite and easy to create.  it's also easy to put together from scratch, without using leftovers.  i've provided amounts as a guideline but the recipe is very forgiving and can be adjusted or modified for more or less, depending on how many ingredients you have on hand.  also - if your stuffing isn't very savory, you can add more herbs to either your turkey mixture or your stuffing mixture - or both!!

name: Beets In Sour Cream
description: this recipe comes from a little book called abc jiffy cookery. i've had it for over 50 years. i haven't tried any of the recipes yet. i'm putting them here so i can find them easier.

name: Death By Chocolate Brownies
description: chocolate lovers' heaven - calorie counters' hell! these are sooooo good, but very, very evil! go on, try 'em - i know you can't resist them! recipe is from the australian 'country style' magazine.

name: Death By Chocolate Bombe
description: this is a truly decadent dessert. tread with caution though as this is a very rich dessert (a heart attack waiting to happen - though you might think it was well worth it when you try this). a true chocolate lover's delight, but go easy - my brother-in-law had almost the entire bombe in one sitting and truly regretted the after effects.

name: Deannas Southern Sipper Punch
description: the ultimate southern punch from my friend...passed through her family!  it has been at many a kentucky wedding!

name: De Lightful Pasta Salad
description: this is a great pot luck or picnic recipe. one that is tried and true! it has a sweet-sour dressing that does not overpower the vegetables and pasta.  it is one of my favorites! give it a try and take it to your next picnic. you won’t be sorry!

name: Day Old Bathwater Punch
description: does this sound gross or what?! but maybe you need a cool beverage for a construction site, or for a teenager's party...whatever! looks can be deceiving!

name: Easy Cheesy Chicken Parmesan
description: this is a quick, easy way to make chicken parmesan.  the chicken breasts are baked--not fried--so i like to think it's a healthier version.  enjoy!

name: Easy Breakfast Sausage Patties
description: this reminds me of the sausage my dad made with venison. i didn't like eating "bambi", but i loved his sausage. while i am not normally a breakfast eater, i have seen some rather luscious pancake and french toast recipes posted. add some maple syrup and i'll join you for brunch! the recipe is from bon appetit 1989. prep time includes refrigeration.

name: Dawn S Salmon Mousse
description: my friend dawn made this dish for her daughters baby shower many years ago, and it was so good i begged her for the recipe... it is delicious on crackers, but it would be good on baquettes, and pita or bagel chips too.  all i can say is yummmmmmmmmmmy!  cooking time means chill time too.

name: Beginner S Pulled Pork
description: america's test kitchen

name: Dave S Special  Adult
description: my dad created this very "special" alcoholic beverage that everyone in our family just loves! it's made with wink or generic grapefruit soda, oj, imperial whiskey and maraschino cherry juice over ice. you could frappe the drink if you want. he also serves them in brandy sniffer glasses. *note: cooking time is none.

name: Easy Cheesy Chicken Skillet
description: this is easy and very good, add in some cayenne pepper for heat if desired, you may use skin on chicken pieces in place of breast but cooking time will need to be increased slightly.

name: Easy Cheesy Lemon Bars
description: hubby loves these.

name: Easy Cheesy Microwave Potatoes
description: my daughters love to cook and this is a recipe they learned from their grandma.  easy to make and delicious.

name: Easy Cheesy Bacon Quiche
description: use a refrigerated pie crust to make this easy and delicious quiche.

name: Deb S Balsamic Chicken
description: my friend deb made this for dinner the other night and it was wonderful!  i begged her for the recipe and thought i would shared it on zaar...

name: Debbie S Pumpkin Bars
description: another recipe from a former co-worker. these bars are delicious, but are certainly not for the diet-conscious (see version #2 for a more healthy option)! i have made them many times (both versions) and they are always a hit.

name: Easy Cheddar Potato Bake
description: this is a really great tater recipe, it's one i have been making for a long time, not only is it easy to make it's so good! you really don't have to have the exact amounts for this recipe, throw in another potato if desired, use as much cheese as as you like!

name: Debbie S Spanish Rice
description: this is a creamy, cheesy, vegetarian version of spanish rice...a great side dish! the recipe was given to me by a friend.

name: Debra S Chocolate Slice
description: another good easy one to fill the tins with :)

name: Decadent Caramel Chocolate Cheesecake
description: this cheesecake is true decadence. not for the timid or those who don't love dark chocolate and caramel. do not look at the calorie count at the side of the page. this is a special occasion cake that will make chocolate lovers say omg.

name: Easy Caribbean Peanut Punch
description: this is an unusual and delicious cold drink.

name: Easy Caramel Cream Trifle
description: you will need a large glass 14-ounce trifle bowl or a large glass dessert bowl for this. purchase the regular size candy bars for this, you can really just use as many bars as you wish. i just purchased the small pudding cups and used them as i could not find a large tub of ready made chocolate pudding. this is a perfect dessert to serve for a dinner party as it can be prepared 24 hours in advance. plan ahead this needs to chill for a minimum of 2 hours or up to 24 hours before serving. chilling time is cooking time.

name: Beef Stroganoff                  Betty Webb
description:
tenderized beef round steak is cut into thin strips to make this easy stroganoff recipe so much more tasty than the "hamburger" stroganoff that is popular with so many.  give this recipe a try.  you and your family will look forward to the next time you make "that great beef stroganoff!"
this dish is best when prepared early in the day, allowing flavors to marry.  reheat and  add the sour cream a few minutes before serving.

name: Easy Camp S Mores
description: i found this to be much easier than the traditional way, less messy and tastes just as good!

name: Easy Cabbage And Noodles
description: i came up with this one because it's fast---no chopping cabbage.  and it's colorful because of the carrots in the cole slaw mix.  cook time is for noodle boiling.

name: Beets In Orange Sauce
description: good for the thanksgiving holidays! quick to make if you use canned beets (plus you won't get your hands all purple!).

name: Easy Butterfinger Trifle Dessert
description: this is a wonderful easy dessert, to save time prepare your cake a day ahead.

name: Beets In Orange Flavor
description: this is an easy recipe for fresh beets. recipe is from "500 fat-free recipes".

name: Decadent Peanut Butter Pie
description: from a jif peanut butter newsletter.

name: Decadent Vegan Chocolate Mousse
description: many non-vegans think of vegan foods, especially the desserts, as not as desirable, to put it lightly, as non-vegan desserts. however, as an omnivore myself, i can assure anyone looking for an amazing chocolate mousse recipe, look no further. the fats and sugars in this recipe are either natural or unprocessed, making this, as most desserts go, rather healthy.

name: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken
description: sounds delish and a healthier version at that.  you can't go wrong with mayo, dijon mustard, ritz crackers and parmesan cheese.  this recipe is from the "joy of eating" cookbook.

name: Crispy Macaroni And Cheese
description: deliciously different. topped with french fried onions for that lovely onion crunch and flavor. if you aren't a fan of mushroom soup use cream of celery.

name: Fresh Tomato Spaghetti Sauce
description: this is my adopted recipe, i haven't made it yet.

name: Cracked Tapas Patatas Braves
description: a classic spanish side dish, it is basically spiced potatoes and often, though not always, includes tomatoes. patatas bravas are a delicious snack in their own right, but make a tasty accompaniment to simple dishes such as my recipe #113295 or recipe #113911.

name: Cranberried Monte Cristo Strata
description:
from ocean spray, 2009 ultimate cranberry recipe contest finalist
janice elder. i haven't made this so i'm guessing the prep time. this needs to be refrigerated 4 hours or overnight. i want it in my cookbook so i'm posting it to share.

name: Flavorful French Onion Soup
description: my kids love french onion soup, without the onion! they like broth and only the broth with the cheese covered crouton. ugh. i combined the best part of  2 recipes to come up with this one. the longer you simmer the soup, the more intense the flavor.  you can make it ahead, turn off the heat and allow it to sit on the stove top until ready to assemble and put in the oven. for the picky kids, i make noodles and ladle the broth over the noodles. everyone is happy!

name: Cran Raspberry Streusel Bars
description: try this on your next cookie platter. recipe courtesy linda tebben and sunset magazine dec. 2007.

name: Flax Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
description: this recipe was provided to me by the red square bakery. these cookies are very healthy for you. you can buy flax at most natural foods stores. grind it fresh in a coffee grinder or a food processor. don't grind it too fine, because you want some roughage and you don't want to overheat the oils in the flax seed.

name: Best Homemade Lamb Gyros
description: after trying several other recipes and being disappointed, i've experimented multiple times to come up with this version.  the meat is tender, flavorful, and pretty darn close to what you get at a very good greek restaurant.  i usually use lamb necks, which are very economical... but it does take some work to get the meat off the bones, and the yield is only about 50%. you need a good food processor and a grill to make this recipe!!  please note that you need to start at least two days before serving.. and three days is better. my fussy 5 year old loves this gyros even though she won't touch a hamburger.

name: Cracker Barrel Green Beans
description: this is the only way i can eat canned green beans!

name: Bean And Bacon Dip
description: this is so easy and soooooo yummy and gets gobbled right up by kids and all!

name: Flavored Butter  Pink Peppercorn
description: *uses: on steak, grilled chicken and fish*. so easy and great to have on hand. flavored butters make a great gift too.

name: Cracked Chocolate Chipper Cookies
description: i have had this recipe for so many years, and it is one of my favorite cookie recipes, whenever i bring these over to someone's house, i always end up by having to give out the recipe, as these cookies have such a wonderful appearance and texture.... everyone just goes wild over these yummy cookies...you will too!

name: Floating Hands Halloween Punch
description: this is a great, spooky brew for a halloween party!

name: Crackaroni  Macaroni And Cheese
description: the most awesome macaroni and cheese ever! so addictive, we call it "crackaroni."  you just can't stop eating this fabulously creamy concoction. i slightly changed the recipe of a coworker who brought it to a potluck. proceed at your own risk.  i can't be responsible for the rise in your cholesterol levels.

name: Flor De Cana Seersucker
description:
think that seersucker is a lackluster fabric donned by stuffy southern elite and wealthy beachcombers?  think again! 

today, seersucker is seeing a major resurgence; becoming a favorite of celebrities, designers, senators, and warm-weather seekers. 

every year, the us senators celebrate the coming of summer by declaring the third thursday in june annual senate seersucker day! the political leaders of our country trade their heavy suits for breathable and fashionable seersucker – and you can join them or sip a celebratory original cocktail! 

this year, as you salute the popular annual senate seersucker day, look to the seersucker, flor de caña rum’s signature summer cocktail, to be as crisp, classic, and refreshing as the fabric itself. this cocktail packs a powerful punch - featuring fresh strawberries and a spicy, tangy cinnamon bark syrup.

name: Crabmeat Cream Cheese Log
